reviews.name: Amit S
reviews.text:
Misleading Suspension Promise Led to a $450 Bill and Collections
I switched from Optimum to Verizon because I was trying to save money on my Internet bill. After Verizon installed the equipment, I contacted Optimum to cancel. Optimum offered me a lower rate and two free months, so I called Verizon to cancel because Verizon said it could not match that offer.
Instead of canceling immediately, the Verizon representative told me my service could be “suspended” for up to three months. I was specifically told I would not be charged during that period and that, if Optimum failed to honor its offer, I could return to Verizon without paying another installation fee. I relied on that explanation.
Optimum honored the rate and free months it promised. I then contacted Verizon to complete the cancellation and returned all Verizon equipment on time. Despite this, Verizon billed me approximately $450, claiming I had never paid my bill—even though I had been told I would not owe charges while the service was suspended.
I explained the situation and the promise made by Verizon’s representative, but Verizon would not correct the charge. Worse, the account was sent to collections. This was an extremely frustrating experience and, in my view, a serious failure of communication and accountability. Customers should not be told they will not be charged, only to receive a large bill later and face collection activity after returning the equipment on time.
I am asking Verizon to review the recorded calls and account notes, remove the $450 charge, withdraw the account from collections, and correct any related negative credit reporting. Until Verizon resolves this fairly, I cannot recommend its service.

DO NOT TRUST VERIZON!!! THEY ARE LIARS AND CROOKS!!!

reviews.text:
I recently decided to upgrade my Fios equipment to Whole-Home Wi-Fi Plus because I wanted better Wi-Fi coverage throughout my home. When I placed the order, I was supposed to receive a new router and two Wi-Fi extenders as part of the upgrade. It has now been more than two weeks, and I still have not received the equipment I was promised.
During this time, I have contacted Verizon customer service approximately 10 times to get an update on my order. Unfortunately, each representative has been unable to provide a clear answer or even determine the status of the equipment shipment. I have repeatedly had to explain the same situation to different representatives, with no resolution. To make matters worse, Verizon sent me an empty box to return my existing equipment, even though I have not received the replacement equipment that I was supposed to receive. This has created additional confusion and inconvenience.
After being a loyal Fios customer for more than 10 years, I find this situation extremely frustrating and unacceptable. I should not have to repeatedly contact customer service just to find out where an order is or whether Verizon intends to fulfill it. I am requesting that Verizon:
1. Immediately investigate and provide the status of my Whole-Home Wi-Fi Plus order.
2. Ship the router and two extenders that were promised as part of my upgrade.
3. Provide a clear explanation for why the equipment was not shipped while I was simultaneously sent a box to return my existing equipment.
4. Ensure that I am not charged any additional fees or penalties related to returning equipment while Verizon has failed to provide the replacement equipment.
I would like this matter escalated to someone who can actually review the order and resolve it rather than directing me back to general customer service.

complaints.text:
I am submitting this complaint regarding Verizon Fios and ongoing billing issues related to my home internet and phone services.
I currently have Verizon Fios 1 Gig internet and home phone service. At the time I agreed to upgrade from my previous 300 Mbps plan, I was quoted a monthly rate of $75.74. I accepted this upgrade specifically because of that quoted price, and I have documentation and photos confirming the agreed-upon amount.
Despite this, my bill is consistently approximately $10 higher than the price I was quoted. When I contacted Verizon customer service to resolve the discrepancy, I received different explanations each time I called. On multiple occasions, representatives were rude, unhelpful, and I was even disconnected during calls.
This issue is not about the additional $10 itself it is about transparency and honesty in billing. Verizon provided a price in writing, yet appears unable or unwilling to honor or properly explain the charges on their end. This pattern of overbilling and inconsistent customer service is unacceptable and misleading to customers.
I am requesting assistance in holding Verizon accountable for honoring the pricing that was originally quoted and correcting my billing going forward. Consumers should be able to rely on written offers without fear of unexpected charges or poor treatment when seeking resolution.
Thank you for your time and attention to this matter.

complaints.text: I had a Walmart+ subscription and a Walmart account for online purchases. I used it multiple times a week for food purchase and delivery to my handicapped brother in Tuckerton NJ. Apparently when they knocked to deliver the food on an occasion he answered the door in his underwear and the driver was upset. I spoke with the manager and told them to just drop the orders off and we proceeded and all was fine. All of a sudden my account stopped working and it said that my account had been closed. I tried to call and they have my number blocked and will not accept a call to customer service. The account is closed and locked in the system. And now I have received a renewal of my subscription notice and cannot contact anyone to cancel. This is a horrible way to treat a long-term customer and just to outright block every mode of communication and refuse to even address the reason for the cancellation is terrible business. I understand Walmart could care less because they are so huge. But as far as consumer protection they should have to at least inform and not renew an automatic subscription. At one point when I went to an actual store to try to understand no one was willing to even figure out what the problem was. So if possible please contact them to make sure I am not charged. I sent an e mail to the corporate e mail and never received a response.

complaints.text:
On July 26, 2026, my wife and I created a Walmart baby registry called “Lourdes Registry: REMOVED 
On August 4, our friend Olivia Hayse purchased a beige 3-in-1 baby bouncer from the registry for $63.58. Walmart Order #REMOVED. It arrived scratched.

On August 20, I returned it to a Walmart store in ZIP code 21060 using a return QR code generated through my account. The employee said that, because it was a registry gift, the full value would be issued as a Walmart gift card to my account and the gift giver would not be involved.

The gift card never appeared. After several calls, I returned to the store on September 1. The store told me to call customer service, while customer service repeatedly told me to resolve it in person. Walmart eventually claimed the refund had been sent to the gift giver and told me to ask her for the money.

This contradicts what I was told when Walmart accepted the return. I will not embarrass my friend by asking her for money she spent on a baby gift. At the time, I was unemployed, and my wife and I planned to use the gift card to buy diapers.

Walmart has the returned product, while we have neither the item nor the promised gift card. I request that Walmart add a $63.58 gift card to my account, as promised.

reviews.text:
I had an extremely disappointing and frustrating experience with this dealership. After discussing the purchase of a vehicle, I was asked to place a deposit to hold it — which I did in good faith. At no point was I told that my driver’s license was a condition for holding the vehicle, nor was it made clear that the vehicle could still be sold to someone else despite my deposit.
Without any proper communication or discussion, the dealership went ahead and sold the car to another buyer. I was simply informed after the fact, with no effort to resolve the situation or respect the agreement. This kind of behavior is not only unprofessional, but also deeply disrespectful.
Taking a customer’s deposit and then backing out without consultation shows a serious lack of integrity. The customer service was poor throughout the process, and I felt completely disregarded as a client. I would strongly caution others from doing business with this dealership.

reviews.name: Peter L
reviews.text:
I purchased a 2018 Cadillac from Scranton Motors. The salesmen was pleasant, finance manager was pleasant as well. After taking the vehicle off the lot I was excited and felt good, literally the next day the LED marker lights went out on the driver side. I immediately emailed the sales manager that I worked with and he shared to bring the car in and that "they will take care of it" I bring the car in and I am told that they will have to run things by the Sales Manager. I leave and got back to work to get an email stating that it's a cosmetic issue and it will cost me over $1,500 dollars to fix. So let's recap, I purchased the car on January 26th 2024 then January 27th 2024 the LED marker light goes out. Then on Monday the 29 I go back to the dealer thinking they will make me whole and fix the issue. I am essentially told it's your problem now, because it's considered cosmetic??? In other words you sold something that was fine, and a day later something is wrong that costs a lot to fix, and Scranton Motors just decided to take no accountability what so ever. No offer to meet me half way, nor offer to take care of it as I had the car overnight. BUYERS BEWARE, DO NOT PURCHASE VEHICLES FROM THIS DEALERSHIP AT ALL. It does not matter whats covered or not, taking a vehicle off the lot, then a day later having something go wrong and it not be taken care of in order to ensure good Business, is BAD BUSINESS

complaints.text:
My letter to the president of the company:
I have been experiencing multiple severe failures with the pre-owned car that I purchased from Scranton Motors in REMOVED. Even at this moment, I am without my car while I wait for the service team to figure out what is wrong with it.

I purchased a 2017 REMOVEDwith 55,998 miles on it.
Total sale price $33834.32
As of yesterday when I left it with your service department again it had 58,051 miles.
I took possession of the car Jan 18th.
I was provided a 60 day dealer warranty and I purchased the additional platinum warranty coverage for 4 years/40,000 miles.

I work from home. I use my car to take my son back and forth to school, and Karate during the week and to run errands and attend family events on weekends.
My husband needs his car to get back and forth for dialysis.
When I am without my car, it has a very negative impact on our family especially considering our medical needs. As it stands I am continually having to reschedule medical appointments for myself because of these repeat issues. It has been extremely stressful and I don't think I can handle much more.


Since getting the car I have experienced the following:
Continued sputtering and now bucking from the car when I accelerate (first reported just over 2 weeks after getting the car)- still not resolved.
The plastic cover on the back bumper falling off (resolved)
The rear hatch light was allowing water to leak in (resolved)
Air conditioner that does not work- unsure if fully resolved
Repeat check engine lights
Repeat days without a car
Below is the work that has been done thus far:
They repaired the plastic cover on the rear bumper
They repaired the rear hatch light that was allowing water to leak in
They have replaced the transmission torque converter
They have replaced a leaking line in the air conditioner
The have flushed the transmission system
They have replaced a catalytic converter
They have tightened a loose connector
The replaced the engine air filter
I have attached a complete breakdown of the series of events since I purchased the car. It is a lot to read, but I have experienced multiple repeat issues in just 3 months and I feel it's important that you have the details. Please note, my service advisor Johnathan has been very compassionate and understanding.

6 years ago we bought my husband a used 2010 REMOVEDfrom a small corner car lot. In that time we haven't even had half of the issues that my car has had in a short 3 month period. I want to believe that the REMOVEDbrand is a good brand and I purchased from Scranton motors expecting a great experience considering you have been in business for 77 years.

My car still has a check engine light and they have it now.
I have been without a car for numerous days through this process.
Now they think it could be the ECM/ECU unit, but are unsure. I am supposed to get a call this afternoon but I expect I will not get any clear answers.

I now believe I may have been sold a lemon. I don't k

On June 21st, 2023 I brought my car to Scranton Motors for an oil change. This was not my first time bringing my car there even thought my oil changes were approx $170. I figured they would be the best place to bring my REMOVED. Right after my oil change they did, my check engine light came on while driving to REMOVED. My light has not come on once in the years I’ve owned my vehicle. I then brought it straight to REMOVEDto have them diagnose the problem. It came up as an O2 issue and was advised to try a new cabin air filter. So, I purchased it and it was installed. The light then came back on and off and my car started to jolt when accelerating. I finally got into a garage to diagnose the issue seeing that is was not going away. This mechanic asked if anyone has worked on my vehicle in the last few months. I informed him that Scranton Motors performed an oil change a few months back and that my car has not been the same since. His advice was bring it back to them because there were like 4 misc codes that most likely was done by someone working on my car. That being said I called them up and told them all my information and asked if they could take a look at my car since it’s happened ever since they did work to it. I was then told I would have to pay $170 for them to diagnosis it. It was shocking that this business would charge me that amount for them to check on a problem that they caused. On top of not being able to just take a look for me, the service manager said “He’s super busy.” This establishment is shady and that being said they lost my business for good. I am a returning customer and they want to charge me for an issue that they should have to fix. It’s infuriating that a dealership can take advantage of a loyal customer like that. I just want my car to run like it had before Scranton Motors performed services on it.
complaints.businessResponse: We performed an oil change & tire rotation on 6/21/23 on a 2017 REMOVEDwith 59,080 miles.   What we did would not cause the check engine light to come on. Every vehicle gets scanned before it is worked on for this reason. This vehicle had multiple fault codes before it even came in the shop. We have been in business for over 70 years and do not have deceptive practices.  Again, this was not caused by the work that was done here.  As a gesture of good faith I would be willing to split the cost of the diagnose and would be willing to offer a discount for the repairs that would be needed.

reviews.text: I got my United UA 819 flight from REMOVEDto REMOVEDcancelled twice in a row. The first flight got deplaned and the second one got cancelled right at the checking time. When I finally could board in the third day, the aircraft didnt have WiFi and the food limited. I also spent money Ubering to the REMOVEDfrom REMOVEDfor two days. reviews.name: Guga M
reviews.text: My experience with United Airlines and the REMOVEDUnited Explorer Card has been absolutely disgraceful We have United Explorer cards and specifically pay annual fees for benefits like checked baggage. My wifes United ticket was purchased using pooled United MileagePlus miles, and the taxes and fees were charged to my United Explorer Card. Yet when it came time to use the baggage benefit, suddenly there was a technicality explaining why the benefit couldnt be honored Think about how ridiculous this feels as a customer: REMOVEDflight. REMOVEDmiles. United credit card. United cardholders. And somehow United still finds a reason to charge for the bag This is the kind of nickel-and-diming that makes customers feel completely taken advantage of The most frustrating part isnt even the cost of the bag. Its the principle. Companies advertise these cards with attractive travel benefits, collect annual fees from customers, encourage us to spend on their cards and stay loyal to their airline and then when its time to actually receive a simple benefit, youre introduced to fine print and technicalities If your benefits require customers to study pages of terms and conditions to figure out whether a suitcase qualifies, perhaps theyre not much of a benefit I spent far more time dealing with United customer service over a checked bag than any customer should have to. Instead of recognizing the absurdity of the situation and simply taking care of a loyal customer, I was given explanations about policies and systems United and REMOVEDshould be embarrassed that this is the customer experience attached to a cobranded credit card carrying an annual fee.Keep the baggage fee. At this point, its worth more to me as a REMOVEDabout how United and REMOVEDtreat loyalty Ill think twice before putting another dollar of spending on this card or choosing United when I have another option.

reviews.name: Corrine C
reviews.text: I am extremely frustrated with how United Airlines has handled a canceled ticket and the resulting charge.I purchased a ticket and canceled it within 24 hours. United has repeatedly told me that they never actually received the money, that the transaction was only a temporary authorization/hold, and that United voided the hold.However, my bank, USAA, shows that the transaction was completed and the money was taken from my account.Because REMOVEDcontinued to tell me they did not have the money, I filed a dispute with REMOVED. During the dispute process, United responded by stating that the charge should stand because I purchased a non-refundable ticket. This directly contradicts what United has repeatedly told me: that they never received the money in the first place.That is the most concerning part of this situation. United cannot tell me they never received my money while simultaneously providing information to my bank arguing that the charge is valid and should not be reversed.I have contacted United multiple times trying to resolve this and have gotten nowhere. At this point, my bank says the transaction was completed, United says they do not have the money, and I am the customer left without the funds.I am simply asking United to fully investigate where this payment went and provide documentation showing whether the transaction was settled, voided, or refunded. A customer should not have to go back and forth between an airline and their bank trying to locate money from a canceled transaction.This experience has been incredibly frustrating and has significantly diminished my trust in United Airlines.

reviews.name: Tanna H
reviews.text: On August 31, 2026, United Airlines processed seventeen separate $129 charges for a single transaction. Only one charge was authorized. The other sixteen were duplicate charges totaling $2,064, meaning United charged or held a total of $2,193 from our bank account.The duplicate charges nearly emptied our account, leaving us unable to pay rent and forcing us to cancel or postpone veterinary appointments. United acknowledged that the charges would be refunded but told us it could take seven to ten days.Returning money that should never have been taken is the bare minimumit does not address the immediate financial harm caused by depriving a household of more than $2,000 without warning. At the time of this review, United has not restored our access to the money, reimbursed the resulting expenses, or offered meaningful compensation for the disruption its billing failure caused.We have requested immediate reversal of all sixteen duplicate charges, reimbursement for any directly resulting fees or losses, and appropriate customer-care compensation. I will update this review to reflect whether United handles this situation responsibly.

reviews.name: Christopher C
reviews.text: 1 star United closed my MileagePlus account without telling me I signed up for United MileagePlus and received an email from United confirming my account and REMOVEDnumber. Shortly afterward, I took an international trip that should have earned more than REMOVEDmiles.Four months later, I discovered I couldn't access my account. REMOVEDinitially told me there had been an attempt to log in and that someone had answered security questions incorrectly. I have never used security questions to log into this account.I was then told that United's Corporate Security team had actually closed my account due to "missing security features." Silently closing a customer's account, providing contradictory explanations, potentially preventing more than REMOVEDmiles from being credited, and offering no direct way to speak to the department responsible is not acceptable customer service.

reviews.name: Amber M
reviews.text: They stole my phone. First, the plane was delayed several times, but I hate the way different airports operate the same airline differently. When I arrived from REMOVEDto REMOVEDI didn't have to combine my bags to get on the plane, but leaving from REMOVEDthey made me combine my bags. I set my phone on the gate agents desk by the keyboard. They were REMOVEDus so I rushed to get on the plane. We sat at that gate for no less than 15 minutes. No one brought my phone on the plane. Even the flight attendant didn't understand why. Plus, I was one of the last people to get on the plane and the gate area was just about empty. I submitted a lost report and nothing happened. United Airlines stole my phone. If it would have been someone on the plane my watch would have found it. The last place it pinged was at the gate.

reviews.name: Kevin g
reviews.text: I arrived a REMOVED. Tried to check in but nome the kiosk were functional. 7:00 pm terminal A. There were no employees on the floor to help and 30 people waiting to check in. I asked for help but baggage claim advised they dont work for United and then sent me over to United REMOVED. 7:12 pm so you can check your cameras. I asked for some help. She said no. I asked for customer service and she yelled at me to get out. My child finally got one of the kiosk to work after 30 minutes so we could check into the flight I had already paid for. No customer service and no customer service number to contact. If my daughter didnt get your equipment to work we would have had to find another flight. I booked this one. But I will never book again with a company with no customer service or employees. I hope my daughter is not needed to work on the plane. This is the last time I fly United or any airline associated with them.

reviews.name: Alijah W
reviews.text: My whole vacation was ruined do to airline failure. complaints.text: United's website error prevented me from using valid travel credits, forcing an unexpected $528.40 out-of-pocket expense. The next day, needing to travel on my original date, I tried booking through the specific link in my travel credit dashboard. The system malfunctioned, displaying: "Your itinerary cannot be retrieved, since it does not contain any active flight segments."Because of this error, I was locked out of applying my credits. Due to the flight's imminent departure, I couldn't wait on hold and was forced to pay the full $528.40 fare with my credit card to get REMOVEDattempts to resolve this yielded conflicting information from three United departments:1. Reservations: Claimed I had to call to rebook to use the credit, contradicting the online booking link provided in my account.2. Refunds: Advised I had a valid case to receive a refund for the unused credit amount.3. REMOVEDDenied the request entirely, stating I should have applied the credits before booking the new flightcompletely ignoring that their own system error prevented me from doing exactly that. They now refuse further assistance.Ultimately, United profited an additional amount for the exact same flight due to their own system malfunction.Desired Resolution Desired Settlement: Partial Refund I am requesting a partial refund to my credit card for the new $528.40 charge, specifically matching the exact amount of the unused travel credit. United may then void the equivalent travel credit from my account. I just want the promised credit retroactively applied to this booking to make me whole for the system malfunction. And basically told me I was SOL with the $6000 that was stolen from me.

complaints.text: Dear Customer Service,I am writing to formally dispute multiple overdraft fees recently assessed on my account. These charges are excessive and disproportionate to the transaction amounts.I previously contacted your customer service team to address this matter and requested escalation. I was advised that I would receive a follow-up call; however, I have not received any response. This lack of follow-through is unacceptable and has further compounded my REMOVEDthis time, my account remains in a negative balance, and I am concerned that additional overdraft fees may continue to accrue. Notably, when calculating the total overdraft fees already charged, the amount exceeds my current negative balance, which raises serious concerns about the fairness and structure of these fees.Given these circumstances, I am requesting the following:1. A full and immediate review of all overdraft fees assessed on my account;2. Reversal or refund of the overdraft fees as a courtesy, particularly those associated with small-dollar transactions;3. Immediate placement on an account setting or plan that prevents overdraft fees from being charged in the future (such as declining transactions rather than approving them with a fee);4. Written confirmation that no additional overdraft fees will accrue while this matter is under review.If this issue is not resolved promptly, I am prepared to file a formal complaint with the Consumer Financial REMOVED(CFPB) and pursue further action as necessary.I request a response within a reasonable timeframe confirming receipt of this dispute and outlining the steps being taken to resolve it. I can be reached at the contact information listed below.Thank you for your immediate attention to this matter.Sincerely,REMOVED

complaints.text: I am filing a complaint against Wells Fargo regarding repeated and improper monthly service fees on my Everyday Checking account ending in 1819 (debit card ending in 6817). I received contradictory information from Wells Fargo representatives that directly caused these fees. Back in April, I called and was explicitly told that even if my balance dipped below the minimum requirement for a few weeks, as long as I restored the balance before the end of the month, I would not be charged the $15 fee. I followed that instruction and deposited funds above $1,000 because that is what I was told the requirement was at the time. Despite this, Wells Fargo still charged me the April 30 fee. I later learned the minimum was actually $1,500, but this appears to be a newer policy change that was not communicated clearly. In July, I temporarily withdrew funds to help a family member, but I restored the balance on July 29 with a deposit of over $1,900. Even though the balance was corrected before month-end, Wells Fargo still charged me the July fee. I have now been charged multiple fees that were directly caused by misinformation from Wells Fargo staff.When I called recently, the representative was dismissive, rude, and repeatedly talked over me. She falsely claimed that only one reversal is allowed per 12 months, even though I already received a reversal earlier this year and Wells Fargo policy clearly allows additional reversals at supervisor discretion. She then said she would get a manager and abruptly hung up on me. I am requesting that Wells Fargo reverse the remaining improper fees (April 30 and July 31) and correct my account. If REMOVEDrefuses to resolve this matter, I will escalate this complaint to the REMOVEDand other oversight agencies for further review. Reference number: CMPP082826e2be3efc9cad. My name is REMOVED.

I am writing to formally lodge a complaint regarding my recent experience with Midas, where I was employed until my wrongful termination. Secondly, during my employment, I observed a considerable lack of organization within the company. The workplace environment was chaotic, and there were no standardized procedures to ensure smooth operations. This disorganization affected not only the employees but also the overall efficiency and customer satisfaction. Moreover, the company failed to provide essential uniforms and supplies required for employees to perform their duties effectively. This lack of basic provisions hindered our ability to maintain a professional appearance and deliver quality service to customers. Additionally, there was no designated employee lunchroom, which is a basic necessity in any workplace. This absence forced employees to find alternative and often inconvenient arrangements during their breaks, impacting our well-being and productivity. complaints.businessResponse:
Mr. REMOVEDbrought his Miata in for a no-start condition in September 2024. During diagnosis, it was determined that the camshaft and crankshaft sensors were not registering. Based on the $1,500 provided by Mr. REMOVEDnew sensors, a coil, and spark plugs were installed. Please see the attached invoice for reference.
The vehicle was returned after a few months with a new issuewhile it would start, it would shut off after approximately ten minutes. Additional diagnostics were performed, leading to the conclusion that a potential short in the wiring harness was causing a no-spark condition. The previously replaced parts were confirmed to be functioning properly and were not the cause of the current issue.
It was recommended that Mr. REMOVEDtake the vehicle to a shop specializing in electrical repair for further diagnosis. No charge was applied for the diagnostic. REMOVED, the store manager, attempted to explain the findings to Mr. REMOVEDhowever, he was unwilling to accept the explanation and demanded either a refund or for the shop to resolve the issue. REMOVEDreiterated that, unfortunately, there was nothing further the shop could do and recommended he seek assistance from an electrical specialist.
Ultimately, the vehicle was towed to Mr. REMOVEDresidence at no cost to him.

complaints.text: On Friday, September 6, 2024 I spent $1,162.68 for my brakes to be replaced on a 2021 REMOVEDPalisade. I dropped the truck off at 8am and picked it back up at roughly 3:30pm. Upon inspecting the sun roof, there was a white grease like residue on both sides of the roof's track to suggest that the shop used this substance to for the roof closed, after some unreported accident happened at the shop with my vehicle. On Monday September 9, 2024 at 8am I went back to this business to ask for an explanation but instead was met with aggression and denial and ultimately threatened to be sued for harassment. At no point did I raise my voice nor use profanity which is not the case for the onsite manager REMOVED. About This Business
Jiffy Lube provides automotive lubrication service and other vehicle services for foreign and domestic vehicles. This company provides preventative maintenance and specializes in oil changes and filter changes which focuses on four key areas of vehicle maintenance: changing the oil and filters of the vehicle, inspecting the inner components, checking and filling the components, and cleaning and dirty elements to ensure that the car continues to run smoothly and to prevent any unnecessary friction. Jiffy Lube provides other preventative maintenance services, including those for the fuel system, electrical system, drivetrain, cooling system, air filtration system, air conditioning system, transmission, and windshield repair and inspection, as well as inspections and emissions. The company also offers fleet service and maintenance for fleets larger than five cars.

reviews.text: After being what I thought was a valued customer for 15 years, I would like to devastatingly end my relationship with this location and overall business. I originally went in for an oil change and it was discovered that I had multiple oil leaks. The manager REMOVED, rang me up for a $200 oil change and told me that it is recommended to change my valve cover gasket to stop the leaking. So on last Thursday I returned and REMOVEDtold me to come in the next day when a Machanic would be available. So I returned on last Friday for them to fix the valve cover gasket where they said the leaking was occurring. After the job was said to be completed and replaced an invoice was printed and given to me that had a brake technician listed as the mechanic and it had no part or part number information on it to prove a part was ordered. Nor was a post inspection report listed on the invoice either.They just pulled my car out and handed me my keys. I went to meineke where I received shocks and strut work done and they provided a full inspection report that showed video of an active oil leak still existing. I returned to jiffy same location of service where there REMOVEDwas available. I told REMOVEDthe concern and she pulled my car in then avoided me. She told me to go up the street to Amcco and had my car pulled out of the bay in a very dismissive manner. I even told REMOVEDhow I felt unsafe driving home and she ignored me and kept walking off. After the job was said to be completed an invoice for $248.99 was printed that had a brake technician listed as the mechanic and it had no part or part number information on it to prove a part was ordered. I returned to jiffy and showed REMOVEDthe report. she pulled my car in but then avoided me. After 45 mins REMOVEDadmitted using glue and tells me and my father that there is transmission fluid and oil leaking from the oil pan and how they dont fix that issue there. I asked Why was this not done, and why say it was coming from only the top, when now youre saying its coming from the bottom? She told me to go up the street to Amcco and had my car pulled out of the bay. I said i felt unsafe driving home and she ignored me and kept walking off. She did not order a part or properly fix the oil leak I paid for services that made the it worst

I went to Jiffy Lube #REMOVEDon 12/13/2025 for an oil change. On 12/14/2025 my check engine light came on my car also with my dashboard stating that "engine power has been reduced", basically my car went into limp mode to prevent damage to engine. I called #REMOVEDon 12/16/25 and spoke with REMOVEDwho said to bring the vehicle bac k for them to have a look. I informed I didn't want to drive vehicle that far because I live on other side of town. He then told me to go to closer Jiffy Lube REMOVEDdid, I went to #REMOVED. In for which I was informed I had an excessive overage of oil in my vehicle. They drained the oil to get to correct level. They scanned my vehicle for the check engine light which gave the PO299, which is for my turbo in my engine. Tech then told me is more than likely that the excessive oil leaked into my turbo. I then recalled #REMOVEDand spoke with REMOVED(was told he was a manager) who was very rude & unprofessional, told me I had to speak back to REMOVED, so I ended call with him. I called back this morning to speak to REMOVEDwho then yells at me, told me to never call there again and hung up on me. My vehicle is still broken & I have to REMOVEDfor an investigation to even be initiated

My local Jiffy Lube location damaged my 2015 Chrysler 200 S during an oil and air filter service. My car is shaking, wobbling, making knocking noises, and the check engine light is on. The store is refusing to provide insurance information. I need corporate to open a damage claim immediately and provide the insurance contact. My engine is as if it about to blow up and I no longer trust the vehicle even if jiffy lube fixed it my 5-year-old is scared.

They messed up one of the lights of my car when they worked on another one and when I went to have them check they ended up telling me it was my fault saying that if it was their fault I would've come back the next day. Horrible service, long wait moreover they give you a receipt that says they did all sorts of checks in your car that they never did. Ive had great experiences in the past with jiffy at other locations and I stopped by this location because my oil level was very low trusting that they will service it properly. They recommended I replace 2 lights that were not working (the front headlight, and the reverse light both in the right side of the vehicle), and I went ahead with their recommendation. I drove off right after because I had to catch a movie with my family and the same day I noticed that different light stopped working (the right back turn signal). This happened 2 weeks ago and since its a location a bit farther from my house I hadnt returned to get it checked. I stopped by today and explained the situation to the guy in charge at the location and without even checking he just said that he could tell it wasnt their fault and that I needed to buy yet another light from them. There was no manager on site. The attendant was rude and started accusing me of trying to get a free light out of them when they worked on my car and damaged my light and refused to check their work.Never going back to jiffy for anything after the way I was treated. Furthermore, I would like my money back from the installation of the lights (REMOVEDfor the head light and REMOVEDfor the reverse light) and the replacement of the light they messed up (unsure about this one but the guy mentioned they're REMOVED, I haven't check anywhere else to see if that is actually the price to replace the turn signal light).

I visited Jiffy Lube on March 5th to get an oil change. They recommended that I also receive a fuel system cleaning service. My car was driving and starting fine before I received these services. The next following day my vehicle wouldnt start. I proceeded to take get my car towed to Jiffy Lube so they can fix the problem. Jiffy Lube told me that the problem was fix but the next following day my car wouldnt start again. Jiffy Lube assistant manager was willing to come to my place of residence to see what the problem is but couldnt find out what was going on. I then proceeded to get my vehicle towed to a mechanic I trusted. The mechanic told me that my engine was damaged and it needed to be replaced. I sent Jiffy Lube the report of my vehicle diagnostic test. Jiffy Lube wanted to take my car to their own mechanic and see what the problem could be. Their mechanic results were different from what my mechanic tested. Jiffy Lube mechanic found out that I needed spark plugs and a Val REMOVEDOnce their mechanic fixed what he thought what was wrong with my vehicle the next following day my vehicle didnt start. I then proceeded to take my vehicle to the dealership to get another diagnostic test. Once the dealership completed their diagnostic test I sent that information over to Jiffy Lube and havent heard back from them. This has been an ongoing situation for almost a month and nothing has been resolved. Im coming out of pocket paying for rentals with money I really dont have just to get back and forth to work. The store manager at Jiffy Lube has been horrible with communicating any updates. Im not allowed to speak with anyone managing that store. This situation has not been handled correctly and Ive tried to be patient and understanding but I feel like Jiffy Lube is trying to get out of fixing a problem they created.

I took my 2017 Didge charger sxt to Jiffy Lube on Cassopolos St in REMOVEDI provided the mobile one synthetic oil and filter. Jiffy lube changed my oil and replaced the filter. I drove home and parked the vehicle until the following morning when I drove to REMOVED. REMOVED. I spent the day there and returned home that same evening. Iwas leaving when my renter noticed I was leaking big spots of oil. When I returned home he told me about the drpping oil...I called my gf and she checked her driveway and t had an oil spot where my car was parked. I had been there two days prior to that and no oil spots from my REMOVEDher driveway on that date. The mechanic at Jiffy lube said they couldn't tell wherevit was leaking, but that it was all over the bottom of the oil pan. He called his boss and the boss recommended that I take it to a mechanic and have them check it over. TThe mechanic where I took it said thatvJiffy Lube had overihhtened the filter. I have his written report that states it was tightened down way more than it should have been. That is what caused it to fail. JIFFY Lube states they didn't cause the problem and their claims department refuses to pay me for the repair I had to have done. It was $756.60. I paid that to have my car repaired. My car was not dripping oil on the ground when I brought my vehicle in for repair. It is evident that the next day oil was leaking from my car in my friends driveway. In addition I have the mechanics statement that it was over tightend when jiffy lube put on the new filter.

I went in to Jiffy Lube on October 23rd, 2024 in order to get an oil change completed and my oil meter reset and filters cleaned while I there I was assured that I had been serviced correctly and I shouldnt have anymore problems however on December 2nd my car began sputtering and the engine had stopped working and it flashed on my dashboard of low oil pressure. How is that possible when I just had my oil changed? So when I went back up to the shop,where they were acting like they had no record of the car being serviced since January but they had the wrong car information and tried to pull the car engine when its never given me that problem before. Then I tired reaching out to the owners of the jiffy lube and they have yet to respond to my emails and are also acting as if I never got my car serviced there at all. I have been waiting for a response and they dont seem interested in resolving the issue.

I got an oil change march 2024. I dont drive this particular car much but I keep up with maintenance. Its time for an oil change now, I went to a different auto shop and they told me they were unable to perform the service because my oil pan sREMOVEDhas been stripped. I called jiffy lines customer REMOVEDwho then emailed the owner. I received an email stating because I was past my warranty there was nothing they could do. I have to continue to drive around to other auto servicing centers to try to get help.

Went to jiffylube in oakpark IL site #REMOVEDfor an oil change. I have a 2013 REMOVEDWas advised on other service. I agreed to a fuel injection service. After car was out of stall, it was parked outside area and a loud noise along with white smoke coming out of exhaust pipe was heard and seen by many who question what was that about. Referring to my car. Tech says oh, that the injection service being cleaned. I drove away after completion for about 20 minutes. My car start shaking making knocking noises and engine light warning starts blinking. I called and the tech says oh, don't worry it does that. It should stop the noise and blinking engine light within 15 minutes I drove back to site #REMOVEDand the tech opened the hood of car and says...your oil is on point. I don't know what that is. It sounds like your engine is bad and since you have a Kia REMOVEDis serving recalls for your cars. They never checked to find an issue, just ignored me and returned to shop. One tech came back out and ask could I move car to the side so another customer could enter the stall I was in line for them to check. Also mentioned it's nothing they could do. They ignored me completely. I didn't know what to do. I drove car home praying it won't stop after acceleration was choking while the knocking continued, car threatening to stop on me. I parked it at home. Next morning of March 16, 2024 i called them again because my car was doing same thing, sounds, knocking, engine light blinking and the oil light on dash also blinks. Car cuts off. I waited a minute 3 times. Still cut off. The tech says we did nothing wrong. We are certified mechanics. You should get with REMOVED. Never check to find issue. Left me standing alongside my car, walked away as if there was no concern. My car is on point for all my services. So are my recalls. Jiffy lube #REMOVEDsite did not manage my vehicle. I want answers

reviews.text: My husband and I are both disabled, we took my car in for what we thought was a loose pully, that was on April 14th. Then was told it'd be the next day between 1-2 pm. I went down at 1:30 pm, sat there for 4 hours before being told it'd be the NEXT day because they didn't put part of the timing chain back on right. Yesterday the 18th, I called and was told they would drop it off to me that day. No phone call, no car. Had been told they had to buy a special tool for it that cost $300.00, the tool only costs $50.00. They opened at 10 am this morning, I called AGAIN, "Mechanic isn't here yet, I'll have him call when he gets in.....STILL NO CAR and NO CALL. We can't go to Doctors appts, pick up medications or ANYTHING because they are basically holding my car hostage and taking advantage of a Disabled person, trying to jack up the price to $700 plus labor for a job that should have only taken 6 1/2 hours and they've had it now for 6 days.

reviews.text: At first we thought everything was great. We had a great deal on homeowners and auto insurance, saving a lot of money after switching from State Farm. reviews.name: jane s.
reviews.text:
First off, let me say Ive always made it a point to support small, local businessesbut only the ones that operate with basic ethics and professionalism. Unfortunately, that was not my experience here.I reached out to this State Farm agency just to get a quote, nothing more. I never gave permission to start a policy. Yet somehow, two weeks later, I receive a welcome packet and declaration page in the mail. Naturally, I was confused and immediately called the agent. I told him there mustve been some mistakebecause I never authorized any policy. He apologized, claimed he would take care of it, and told me to disregard the REMOVEDforward another couple of weeks, and now my mortgage company is reaching out, saying they paid State Farm from my escrow account. Thats when I realized this was way more serious. I called the agent again, and he tells me the policy was cancelled, but it just takes 15 days to update in the system. That was a lie.I called State Farms REMOVEDnumber myself and spoke to a representative who confirmed the policy was never canceled and is still active. Meanwhile, my escrow account is now overdrawn because of a policy I never asked for, never agreed to, and never signed off REMOVEDtook me getting corporate involved just to get this resolved. This entire situation has caused me stress, financial issues, and wasted timeall because this agent took it upon himself to start a policy without my REMOVEDwarning othersstay far away from this agent. His shady and unprofessional business practices are unethical at best, and flat-out fraudulent at worst. In my opinion, someone like this shouldnt even be allowed to hold an insurance license. If you value honesty, transparency, and proper consentfind a more ethical agent.

reviews.text:
I want to warn other consumers about a deceptive billing practice I experienced with Comcast/Xfinity.On March 11, 2025, I updated my Comcast internet service for my family home in REMOVED, REMOVED, after the passing of my mother. While handling account matters during bereavement, I was offered a promotion for a free iPad and a free Xfinity REMOVEDline.I asked repeatedly via chat if the mobile line would truly be free and was assured several times that it would be. I have transcripts confirming this. The iPad arrived as promised, but to my surprise, I began receiving bills for the free mobile service in April, with a due date in May.I contacted Xfinity support via chat on April 21, and only then was the issue acknowledged and supposedly resolved. I have documentation of that conversation too.This experience was frustrating, misleading, and frankly exploitative especially during a time of personal grief. I acted in good faith. Comcast/Xfinity did not.This feels like a bait-and-switch, and it could easily mislead less experienced customers into ongoing charges for a service they were told was free. Im now left wondering how many others were similarly misled but didnt catch it in time.If youre considering any free promotional offer from Comcast/Xfinity, get everything in writing, save your chats, and double-check your billing.

? Extremely disappointed this has now happened to me twice.I regularly purchase concert tickets and spend a significant amount of money through Ticketmaster. complaints.text: On March 4, 2026, I purchased two tickets through Ticketmaster for REMOVED: BITTER (Brand New Tour!) at the REMOVEDin REMOVED, California, originally scheduled for May 8, 2026. I paid $159.00 for the tickets plus $47.70 in service fees, for a total of $206.70.The tickets remain unused.The show was rescheduled to October 16, 2026, at 7:00 PM. I did not receive any email or message notifying me of the schedule change or a refund request deadline. I discovered the schedule change on May 8, 2026, the original show date. At that time, I did not see information about a refund window and believed a refund would be issued automatically.On September 11, 2026, I discovered that I still had not received a refund and called Ticketmaster. The representative refused my refund request, stating that there had been a refund window. I explained that I had not received notification of that window.I am requesting a full refund of $206.70 to my original payment method, including the $47.70 service fees. I ask Ticketmaster to reopen the refund window for my order because I did not receive notice of the deadline. If Ticketmaster maintains that it notified me, I request a copy of the notice and the date, delivery method, destination, and available delivery records.
complaints.businessResponse:
Hello,


I am in receipt of your recent complaint submitted to the Better Business Bureau. Thank you for bringing your concerns to our attention.


We're terribly sorry to hear you wont be able to make the new event date. The Event Organizer has approved your request. Weve refunded order 59-53425/LA1, and issued $206.70 back to the original payment method used at time of purchase. It should appear on your account within 5-7 business days, depending on your bank's processing time.

Thank you for the opportunity to respond and address your concerns.

 


Sincerely
REMOVED.
Consumer Support Team

complaints.text: I am requesting a review and appropriate refund/adjustment regarding four tickets I purchased through Ticketmaster for the REMOVEDconcert at REMOVED( July 12, 2026).At the time of purchase, only one of the four tickets was identified as having an obstructed view. I understood and accepted that limitation for that specific ticket when making the purchase.However, upon attending the event, all four seats had obstructed views. The three remaining tickets were not disclosed or labeled as obstructed-view seats when I purchased them. Had Ticketmaster accurately disclosed that all four seats had obstructed views, I would have made a different purchasing decision.Ticketmaster's own guidance states that obstructed-view tickets are clearly labeled as such at the time of purchase. That did not occur for three of the four tickets in my order.I have attempted to resolve this directly through Ticketmaster on three separate occasions using the app and have not received a response and/or no resolve. I also attempted to dispute the transaction through REMOVED, but REMOVEDadvised that the transaction was outside of its dispute timeframe.I am therefore requesting that Ticketmaster formally review the original listings for each of my four seats and verify which tickets were identified as obstructed view at the time of purchase. I am requesting an appropriate refund or adjustment for the three tickets that were sold without an obstructed-view disclosure but provided obstructed views at the event.I can provide photographs from the seats, screenshots, ticket information, proof of purchase, and documentation of my previous attempts to contact Ticketmaster.
complaints.businessResponse:
Hello,
 
We are in receipt of your recent complaint submitted to the Better Business Bureau. Thank you for bringing your concerns to our attention.
 
Unfortunately, we are unable to offer courtesy refunds. All sales are final, and refunds are only allowed in limited circumstances, as explained in the Refunds, Credits, and Exchanges section, and the Canceled, Postponed, Rescheduled and Moved Events section of our Purchase Policy. Before purchasing tickets, carefully review your event and seat selection. Policies set forth by Event Organizers generally prohibit us from issuing exchanges or refunds after a ticket has been purchased, or for lost, stolen, damaged, or destroyed tickets.
Seating maps are representative of a venues layout; however, they are subject to change at any time, and refunds are not allowed if the seating map is updated, if additional seats/rows are added, or if seats change as a result of a venue change after purchase.
To review the policy in which you agreed, please follow this link:REMOVED

Thank you for the opportunity to respond and address your concerns.
 
Sincerely,
REMOVED.
Consumer Support Team

complaints.text: My daughter purchased 2 REMOVEDRomantic Tour tickets on January 28th, 2026 for the August 21st 7:00 show at REMOVEDin REMOVED, REMOVEDfor $510.12 through the Ticketmaster website. On the morning of the show, she transferred the tickets successfully to her Apple Wallet. We attempted to enter around 7:15 pm using what looked like an active barcode but it would not scan. The workers at REMOVEDescorted us to the ticket booth where they were able to determine that the tickets had been transferred out of my daughter's account. On her end, my daughter could see that it did say the tickets were transferred to someone named REMOVED. However, my daughter did NOT initiate any transfer and she did not receive any notifications from Ticketmaster that the tickets had been transferred. While at REMOVED, we attempted to get replacement tickets from two separate ticketing booths. We were told there was nothing we could do without purchasing new tickets and then hoping that we would get reimbursed by Ticketmaster. We then called Ticketmaster and were told that their "priority" was to get us into the venue that night. I asked how likely that was and I was told that they "usually are able to do that." We waited outside the venue until 10:00 pm and heard nothing from Ticketmaster. I continued to call them on Saturday, 8/22, Sunday, 8/23 and Tuesday, 8/25. Each time I was told that the issue had been "escalated" and that we would have a response in 3-5 days. When I called on Sunday, I asked if we could try to get replacement tickets to the Romantic Tour shows at REMOVEDthat week and we were told that was in fact a 'priority.' Every time I call Ticketmaster there is a prompt to complete a survey at the end of the call. The 2 times that I called and was clearly disappointed, there was no survey option at the end of the call. I called again today, Saturday, 9/5 because as of that date my daughter has heard nothing from Ticketmaster, I was given the same run around.

I have reviewed this complaint and the related order 3000-0684-7343-2881-3. As a courtesy, this order has been refunded in full and the credit for $510.12 USD will be procesed back to the card used for purchase within 5-7 business days. 

Thank you for the opportunity to respond and address your concerns.
Sincerely
Aran J.
Consumer Support Team

complaints.text: Subject: Refund Request Duplicate Order Due to Price Drop (Order for Event on 11/05/26)I'm requesting a full refund for my original ticket order, which is now duplicative.Timeline of events:I purchased 1 ticket for the event on 11/05/26, paying $58.46 total, well in advance of the event date.On 09/02/26, the event switched to a 2-for-1 pricing promotion with significantly reduced fees. Under this new pricing, I purchased 2 tickets for $40.10 total less than half the price I originally paid, and with much lower REMOVEDoriginal single ticket is now fully duplicated by this new order (I have 3 tickets total for the same event, when I only need 2).Why I'm requesting a refund:The event is not until 11/05/26 over two months away giving ample time to process a refund with no risk to Ticketmaster.This is a clear duplicate purchase: the same event, same seating category, purchased through the same platform.I did not intend to buy 3 tickets; the second purchase was made solely to take advantage of the better price and lower fees now being offered for the exact same event.I'm asking that Ticketmaster refund my original, higher-priced order (the $58.46 single ticket) in full, since it is now redundant given my newer, lower-cost order for 2 tickets.Please let me know what additional information you need to process this refund.

complaints.text: A couple years back my Ticketmaster account was hacked and Ticketmaster couldnt re assure me that my personal information was secure and was advised to change my password. In fear I removed my personal info: credit card info. Flash forward I purchased tickets on 5/7/26 for All things go music festival for 9/25/26 order # REMOVED-20388-WDC for $169.25. Unfortunately I cannot attend this event so I was going to sell my tickets through stub hub. I could not transfer my tickets without a 2 step authentication process which required a code sent to my phone #. But because my account was hacked, my phone number is incorrect. I have contacted Ticketmaster for help, spoke to a customer service REMOVEDnamed REMOVED, who told me they cannot help me since they cant verify my identity. Since they cant verify my identity, I am unable to sell my tickets. This is illegal, my identity is not safe and I would like a refund of my tickets so I can delete my account to protect my information and identity since ticket master cannot be trusted. I find it ridiculous they can only verify my account with the phone number that hacked me and cant find any solution to the problem. Everybody should be careful putting their personal information into Ticketmaster since they obviously cant keep your information secure and cant even offer a solution. Shame on them. I would like my money back so I dont have to associate with them anymore. Also, the credit card attached to that order is no longer correct.
complaints.businessResponse:

I am in receipt of your recent complaint submitted to the Better Business Bureau. Thank you for bringing your concerns to our attention.


We apologize for any inconvenience caused. We have refunded this order in full and you should see the credit for $169.25 back on your card used for purchase within 5-7 business days.


Thank you for the opportunity to respond and address your concerns.


Sincerely,


Iris G


Consumer Support Team

complaints.text: I had tickets for REMOVEDon 08/23 at REMOVEDsun but was unable to attend because my nephew had Covid. I did resell through Ticketmaster on 08/21, the price I paid was much higher than what I was able to sell them for. Ticketmaster sold my tickets on 08/22, I am only getting $119 because even though Ticketmaster charges me fees when I purchased the tickets, I was charged fees AGAIN when I sold the tickets. I was supposed to receive the money 7 days AFTER the concert, which was 08/30, on 08/31 I emailed Ticketmaster about when my money will be deposited, I didnt hear anything back. My complaint email is: REMOVED. I still have not received a response from REMOVEDhave NIT received my money. I want ALL my money plus fees.
complaints.businessResponse:
Hello,


I am in receipt of your recent complaint submitted to the Better Business Bureau. Thank you for bringing your concerns to our attention.


Your tickets will appear on the site at a higher price than this to cover service costs. This difference is paid by the buyer.


Resale service fees are shared among various parties involved in putting on the event and may cover operational costs and profits. For example, Ticketmaster uses these fees to invest in authenticating resale tickets prior to sale to prevent fraud and ensure a safe, secure experience for both buyers and resellers.

We show your payout for listing #P6722-26E has been received by your bank as of September 1, 2026. Please allow 5-7 business days for the funds to appear in your account. 

Thank you for the opportunity to respond and address your concerns.


Sincerely,


Iris G


Consumer Support Team

reviews.name: Book L
reviews.text: front desk staff at my location are RA's who don't know what's going on and constantly give conflicting information about important dates, deadlines, and other information (regarding lease or terms/conditions of lease) and actual management is never there even during standard business hours. my first year living in their community 1 of the 2 elevators on my side of the building broke down just a bit after move in and both elevators had constant issues, with weeks where both of them were out at the same time. there was probably only 3 weeks total in the whole 10 months i was there that both elevators were operational. there was a puke stain in my floor lounge that wasn't cleaned up for a few weeks. my 2nd year living in a different unit, the trash chute on my floor was broken for nearly 4-5 months, so trash from residents would build up in the trash room and my unit later had issues with ants most likely due to our proximity to the trash room. communal restrooms next to the apt gym were always disgusting. ac is confusing to manage (always either too hot or too cold and incapable of maintaining a temperature). oh and in communal areas the tv's are just decor because they never actually work and something is always broken with them. and the pricing of my location is absolutely ridiculous but it is the only available on-campus housing offered, our other complex is next impossible to get a spot in and each year they increase the (already insane rate) by another $100 basically. and they also increase the rate of a parking pass each year. and the whole complex is so far from the parking lot that it is another 5-8 min walk depending on your unit to get to the parking lot so good luck breaking your back taking everything from your car in 1 trip.

reviews.name: Colleen D
reviews.text: Students live in apartments for 9 out of 12 months and we pay for 12. My son moved out after graduation 2nd week in May and had a new apartment in REMOVEDby June 12th. September I received the largest utility bill of the year of $179.20 with no one living in unit. My bank card was stolen so automatic payment was declined. It took 4 weeks to get a new card (totally different experience) I disputed the utility bill as no one lived there in July. Constant email communication as that is the only way they will take a dispute. My son was home this weekend for family event and I was able to log in with him here as password was previously denied for me to pay the bill. The $179.20 bill was $369. and some change. almost $200 for a disputed bill upcharge. NEVER late in the 3 years we've rented from these apartment complexes and again, no way the utilities were that high for an empty apartment. I'm disgusted. No way this company has an A+ rating with BBB.

reviews.name: Cecilia S
reviews.text: Our daughter and her roommate were moved to a different unit due to a leak. The replacement unit was already in poor condition, including a worn-out couch and a stained refrigerator. After only four months, they were charged a large amount for damages, including replacement of these items. They never had an animal, yet the couch had obvious animal-related damage. We disputed the charges, but the property did not adequately consider the pre-existing condition of the unit. This experience left us feeling that they were unfairly held responsible for damage that was already there. Very dissapointing that these charges werent seriously looked into being dropped.

reviews.name: Melanie H
reviews.text: This review should be zero REMOVEDson lived at The Callaway House in REMOVED, and after move out we were assessed multiple charges that I believe are unsupported and, in several cases, contradicted by the propertys own photographs.I will pay for legitimate damage or cleaning my son caused, but not charges for conditions that do not appear to exist.For example, we were charged $50 to clean a drawer. The propertys photo shows only what appears to be a one inch clothing tag and a safety pin! No spilled liquid, food, gum, trash, or significant debris to justify a $50.00 charge.We were also charged for cleaning the bathroom sink and shower/tub area, which I personally cleaned before moving out. There were also charges involving items for which maintenance/work orders had already been submitted, including one placed by another roommate. My greatest frustration has been the inability to speak directly with someone who can address these disputes. Communication is routed through email. Even after making an appointment to discuss the charges, I was directed back to the REMOVEDteam by email.Parents and students considering American Campus Communities or The Callaway House should protect themselves. Take detailed photos and video of every room, wall, drawer, appliance, sink, shower, fixture, and piece of furniture. Save every maintenance request and email. Move-out happens quickly, and without documentation, you may later find yourself disputing charges for conditions you do not believe existed.I am simply asking American Campus Communities to remove charges that cannot be supported by clear evidence and charge my son only for legitimate expenses for which he was responsible.

reviews.name: Carissa R
reviews.text: I applied to The Block on REMOVEDunder the specific understanding that I was applying for a "girls only" unit, that was the basis on which I chose to apply and pay the application/administrative fee. After I paid, I was told this was a mistake and no such unit was actually available.I asked for a refund of the $125 fee, explaining that I only applied because of this misrepresentation and would not have otherwise. In response, I was first told they don't offer refunds, and then didn't hear back at all despite an email where staff acknowledged the issue and attempted to accommodate REMOVEDunderstand application fees are often non-refundable in general, but that policy shouldn't apply when the thing you're paying to apply for doesn't actually exist as advertised. I'm disputing the charge with my bank and would encourage anyone applying here to get unit availability confirmed in writing before paying anything.

reviews.name: Todd J
reviews.text: This apartment is catered towards college students at the REMOVED. It is located near campus, which is the only reason anyone would step foot in one of these apartments. Check the reviews on line before allowing your child to live here. The day I moved my daughter in we spent 8+ hours cleaning the apartment from top to bottom. It was absolutely disgusting. Dirt, mold, wasps everywhere, the TV did not work, and the customer service was atrocious. Every unit was like this, so to get help was next to impossible because they were overwhelmed. It took months to get a simple TV installed and a moldy dishwasher replaced. If these company cared about these young college students, they would at least clean the stairs? Get an elevator that works. The place is simply gross. One of those places after you leave you want to jump in the shower. Buyer beware.

reviews.name: Avisa M
reviews.text: My son lived at Callaway House for one year. After moving out, we received a bill for damages that were not caused by him. The main charge involved a large hole in the wall that we later learned was allegedly caused by his roommate installing a ceiling fan. My son never made any alterations to the apartment the only wall use on his part involved normal thumbtacks.When we first received the bill, I contacted the office multiple times to speak with management and requested an itemized statement of the charges. I left several messages and never received a return call. The only information we were given verbally was about the hole in the wall, but no documentation, photos, repair invoices, or itemized deductions were provided despite our requests.Because management never followed up or attempted to resolve the issue, we believed the matter had either been reviewed or corrected. Instead, six months later, we received a call from a collection agency with no prior communication from the property.What made this experience even more frustrating was what happened when I called after learning the account had been sent to collections. I asked to speak with the manager directly and was told by the front office that she would not speak with me. I was told to either email her or contact the collection agency. After months of trying to resolve this issue, the manager would not even take the call to discuss it. That was when I decided to write this review.Good management communicates with residents and families, responds to concerns, and provides proper documentation before sending accounts to collections. Unfortunately, that did not happen here. It makes me wonder how many other families this has happened to.I would encourage future residents and parents to document everything, request communication in writing, and think twice before leasing at this property. The lack of communication, accountability, and professionalism we experienced was unacceptable.

reviews.name: LeShel R
reviews.text:
The Village at REMOVEDis horrible. Do not send your kids to live there. First, the apartments were supposed to be cleaned prior to move in. This was not the case. There was smeared fREMOVEDon the floor in the bedroom that had to be scrubbed up. There was also urine all around the toilet in the bathroom that had not been cleaned. My daughter had to move in that day so I had to clean all of that. I sent the pictures to the office of the apartment complex. There was also a REMOVEDinfestation. It took them weeks and weeks to get anyone in there to spray and it was a constant battle to stay on top of them to keep the apartment sprayed. When my daughter moved out, we cleaned very thoroughly. I made sure personally that it was clean. They still charged her a cleaning fee. We disputed it but they would not remove that fee.
American Campus Communities

Date: 03/24/2026

Thank you for allowing us the opportunity to respond to this complaint regarding The Village at REMOVED

We sincerely regret the difficulties experienced by the resident and apologize for any inconvenience caused. We understand the importance of providing a clean and safe environment for all our residents.

Regarding the concerns about the apartments condition upon move-in, we acknowledge that the resident sent photographic evidence in August 2024 showing issues with cleanliness.However, this evidence was not shared with management until March 2026, when it was discovered during the recent complaint review. As a result, management was not aware of these concerns prior to that time and was unable to take action earlier.

We also recognize the frustration related to the pest control issues and the time it took to address these concerns. We continuously strive to improve our pest management services to ensure a comfortable living environment.

Concerning the cleaning fee charged at move-out, after a thorough review of the situation and in light of the concerns raised, The Village at REMOVEDhas agreed to waive the cleaning fee as a gesture of goodwill.

We remain committed to maintaining high standards of cleanliness and service and appreciate the feedback, which helps us improve our operations.

Thank you for your understanding.

reviews.name: Rebecca F
reviews.text: This company has allowed unleashed dogs on the property for over a year. The dog pack would go on our property and treat it like a pee pee palace. After a year of complaints, the property finally spoke to the resident but refused to provide contact information for property management or a copy of their REMOVEDso their insurance agent could be informed of the risk going on property. Withholding public information and lack of transparency and communication are major issues. The unleashed dogs is a liability issue for all on property and off.

This company is predatory and abusive to college students, and should be heavily fined, at minimum.
