complaints.text: I used Two Men and Truck on March 4, 2025 at a cost of aprox. $1900.00 to move my household. They moved my TV's and unfortunately broke one (65in). They did not tell me they broke it, i In addition, once we turned it on you could clearly see a spot on the screen where something fell on it, again, they would have known that happened and were not honest with me. They indicated that I had 90 days to make a claim about broken items. I went out of town the next day and did not plug the TV in until about a week later. I discovered it was broken and emailed immediately. REMOVEDis my salesperson. He indicated that he would take care of things and apologized. He did not state that I was past the period of being able to get reimbursed, however called me back and told me that his manager, REMOVED, would not cover this because I had waited too long. I only had 96 hours to file a complaint. This is not what either the driver or REMOVEDsaid. REMOVEDwas aware that I had gone out of town the very next day and that is why it took so long, he did remember me saying that and apologized that his manager would not cover it. I wrote an email complaint. I added that I had a previously planned trip the day after we moved and that is why it was a week later. It was not a fraud attempt. The manager called me and did say they would go ahead and cover it. I sent the needed information and after two follow up emails on my part to remind them I finally did receive an answer. They covered $234.00 of a $2000.00 TV. In addition I have to pay to get rid of the broken TV - $50. So, they broke my TV, lied about it, I had to chase down and fight for them to do the right thing and then I received $234, minus disposal fees for a perfectly fine, $2000, working TV they broke. I would never use this company again. That is simply not fair or right. Not to mention the stress or arguing with them to do the right thing. Terrible company.
complaints.businessResponse: Customer moved with our organization on Tuesday, March 4, 2025. On March 6th, a post move follow up call was done and REMOVEDstated everything went well and her movers were very nice and no damages were reported. We perform these post move follow up calls within 3-4 days of the move as that is the end of the window that damages can be claimed. Customer called in on Tuesday, March 11, 2025 to report damage to her TV. This was 7 days from her move, which was 3 days outside of the customer's window to claim any damages. Customer received a pre-move letter that was sent before her move and she acknowledged and signed the documentation electronically. She also signed the Moving Service Agreement that's presented at the beginning of her move that goes over the damage policy again. Customer also only selected minimal valuation coverage for her items on move day. Both of these documents are attached for review. Based on the valuation the customer selected, she should have only been reimbursed .60 cents per lb. up to $100.00 for any damages. The manufacture weight of her TV is REMOVEDlbs. REMOVEDshould have only received a reimbursement check of $36.78 based on the valuation she selected. In order to exceed her expectations, we gave her the higher valuation at the $3.50 per lb. and reimbursed her $214.55. Based on all documentation that customer signed, REMOVEDshould not have received any compensation as she was outside her window to claim damages. We offered the customer an amount that was based on the maximum value that we would pay out based on the weight and size of the item. We do apologize that these circumstances happened on her move, but we did go above and beyond what our normal business practices are.

complaints.text: We contracted with Two Men and A Truck in REMOVEDto move our household from REMOVED, IN to REMOVED, REMOVED. We chose them largely because of their pitch that our belongings would be loaded onto a truck dedicated to just our belongings. We will not be sharing that truck with anybody else. That is the service we paid for.When our moving truck arrived on Monday, March 25, 2024, the first 6 feet of the truck in the attic section of the truck. Were already loaded with items from the companies owner that he was sending to a location in REMOVED. because it was a non-dedicated truck, roughly 6 feet of our goods did not fit on the truck. Had the owners items not been on the truck, all of our belongings would have fit on the truck. As a result of being forced to share this truck with the owners belongings, a second truck was used to load the rest of our stuff and take it back to their warehouse. Situation also prompted them to send a second crew out to help the first crew pack and try to get it all in one truck but they were unsuccessful. When our belongings left our house on March 25, they left in two trucks instead of the one that we were promised. When we received the first truck (on Tuesday the 26th), we noticed a significant amount of goods on the back had been unloaded. These items appeared on the second truck, which arrived the next day (Wednesday). A significant amount of these items were damaged and broken.Prior to the loading we paid for what they sell as moving insurance. It is supposed to damaged goods. We paid over $200 for a plan with a $500 deductible. The company is now refusing to honor the insurance that we purchased, and claiming they only owe us $.60 on the pound for damages, despite the damages being caused by their negligence and the violation of our original agreement. We just want them to honor the insurance we purchased and pay for or replace the items they damaged during our move.
complaints.businessResponse:
The following e-mail correspondence was sent to the customer. We are currently awaiting on their response and pictures and information on their damage claims. Like the letter states below, we will honor the damages on their move based on the valuation that was selected on move day.

 

Good Evening REMOVED,

I have received your recent complaints regarding your move from March 25, 2024. Please find attached the REMOVEDthat was signed on move day regarding the terms of your move to REMOVED. As you can see from the first page, you signed off on Space Reservation of the truck of REMOVEDof cubic ft. of space of the truck. This amount of space equates to REMOVEDlbs. of household goods, and is equal to 26ft of floor space in the truck. The actual weights of your items on move day came out to roughly REMOVEDlbs. This was over the contracted amount agreed upon by REMOVEDlbs. This additional weight would have added $900.00 based on the Tariff charges. Since there seemed to be confusion on the exclusivity of the truck and to try and exceed your expectations, we did not charge you the additional amount to haul the extra weight.

As far as the damages on your move, this is all outlined on page two of the document that you signed. As it states, this is carrier liability and not insurance. You selected full (replacement) value protection for your shipment which states the following:

In the order for service, you selected the $500.00 deductible for an additional charge of $208.00 which is shown below. What this means is you take the average cubic weight of the items damaged and times it by $6 per lb.

reviews.name: Doug M
reviews.text:
Suggest that you choose a different moving company, or at least choose the fixed price quote option.
Their quoting practices are misleading; they lead you toward selecting the "actuals" option, based on a suggestion that the final price will be lower.
The final price turned out to be over $6000 higher than the estimate, and then two months later, they contacted me again with another supplemental charge for "additional unpacking services" that they claim had not been included in the previous "final" bill.
The packing, loading, and transport services were great. Their quoting practices are suspicious.
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 10/22/2025

The pricing quote provided was in response to the uncertainty about what the disposition with some of the items in the home would be. At the time of the estimate and up until the move began there was a stated intent of possibly leaving some of the items for a relative and that is what the estimate was based upon. However, that had changed, which in turn caused the packing and the weight to increase over original estimate. The driver had to make an additional trip from IA back to IL to get the rest of the items due to this change. There was nothing misleading about the billing being based on actuals or that a price could be lower--we used the best of information provided when the estimate was provided, but that changed when we performed the services based on changes on day of services. The additional billing was in regards to an audit performed that showed we had not billed for the unpacking of 4 TVs at destination.
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 10/22/2025

I am very sorry that you were dissatisfied with our service. I looked at what happened and the packing went from 45 boxes to 142 boxes and the weight went up as well. Apparently, when the survey was done there was some uncertainty about what was going and in the end it looks like most of the items went. We had one of our best drivers on this relocation so I hope you were pleased with his services. If there is anything else I can do to help with this or future relocations please let me know.

Thanks

reviews.name: Darrien D
reviews.text:
Do not use this company. They will tear up your belongings and then try to stall you out and ultimately not pay to replace your valuable items. Their communication is horrible and their claims person Kathlyn has the worst customer service I’ve ever encountered. Again if you want to ever use your items again DO NOT USE this company for your move.
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 08/25/2025

I am sorry that you were no happy with our claims process. If you send me a copy of your claim, I would be glad to review it. Please send it to me at champaign@federalcos.com.

Thanks

reviews.name: Mary T
reviews.text:
My move in 8/30/23:
The home team did a great job packing, etc! My problem is with the driver, Bubba, to my new home in NC from IL who seemed only anxious to get to his next delivery rather than the unloading of my items. He remained mainly in truck while the help he hired, 3 men who worked hard but only 1 spoke and could read a little english. Consequently, labeled items were not places in right rooms. I could only help 1 at a time. There was one very large glass labeled item that I told the driver was not mine. He insisted that his big complaint with my packer was that they mislabeled lots of items and this was pictures. As he was in truck ready to leave, I opened the item and found a name, ran out to ask if had a delivery for that person. He did! When calling to complain about the driver I was told he hires the unloaders at his destination. Advertising by aREMOVEDstates that they use no middle men which in this case is false advertising. I wasn’t aware of this until recently. The insurance did cover most of my damaged items but I still wonder if some of my items went to another place!! …just my experience!!
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 08/12/2025

I am sorry your experience was not to your satisfaction.  I will discuss this with the driver and if you think you are missing something please let me know and I can call the other customers that were on the truck to see if they received it.  Thank You

reviews.name: Stephen G
reviews.text:
We're a retired couple. We contracted with this company to move our home to a new location 9 miles away. We paid over $6K for the move, including over $400 crating and special care of an expensive glass dining table. This was recommended by the sales rep. and thus did not purchase their insurance policy for an additional $700. The $3995 glass table irreparably damaged during loading. More damage to other items. We filed a damage claim as requested. Company response: You didn't buy our insurance, it's not our problem. We are going to pay you $76 for the damages. Buyers beware!
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 01/27/2025

Thank you for sharing your feedback. We apologize for the problems with your relocation. We understand how upsetting it can be when damage occurs during a move, especially to valuable items such as your glass dining table. While we strive to handle all belongings with care, accidents can happen despite our best efforts.
Regarding the matter of coverage, our team recommends additional insurance to provide comprehensive protection for high-value items. In this case, as additional coverage was not purchased, our ability to compensate for damages is limited to the basic liability coverage outlined in your agreement. The settlement offered reflects the terms of that coverage.
We regret that this outcome did not meet your expectations. Please don’t hesitate to reach out if you have further questions.
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 01/27/2025

I am very sorry that you were dissatisfied with our service. We strongly recommend Valuation on all of our relocations. I talked to the salesperson and operations and they mentioned that you opted not to crate the table base and indicated that you would move it yourself. On the day of move the crew was told by you to move this base and that is the item that was broken, not the table top.
I hope this answers your questions and feel free to call or email me if you would like to discuss this further.
Thanks

reviews.name: Mark O
reviews.text:
This was our first time moving in nearly 25 years, and it was a move across the country. The Allied truck arrived at my home in Illinois on time with a crew of happy workers, ready to load out my house. We reviewed the contents before loading, and they began. They took great care wrapping odd items (mirrors, bicycles, Peleton, TVs), and had the entire house loaded onto the truck in a few hours. Joy did an excellent job inventorying every single item, and was very helpful in the entire process. They left for Arizona and greeted my wife a week later with all of our home contents in tact. They loaded into our new house, placed everything in rooms as directed and cleaned up after they finished. From start to finish, exceptional experience. Highly recommended!
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 07/31/2024

Thank you for taking the time to leave a review - we appreciate you trusting us with your cross country move. Enjoy your new home!

reviews.name: Steve V
reviews.text:
Excellent service on a move from Lisle Illinois to council bluffs Iowa. Highly recommend!
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 07/15/2024

Steve, thank you for your business, we appreciate it!

reviews.name: mare b
reviews.text:
Federal Companies did an excellent job of moving my mother from a small apartment in an independent living community in Illinois to a private home in Sacramento. They estimated the job, completed the move-out and move-in as promised. (About 2 weeks from move-out to move in!) The team stayed in touch with me, nothing was broken and they successfully packed some precious irreplaceable artwork. I packed the rest of the belongings. They dismantled the movable bed, an electric go-chair and a power recliner and a crew set them up on arrival. They made the horrible experience of moving bearable. Now to finish unpacking!
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 06/24/2024

Mare, thank you for trusting us with your mother's move - we hope she is enjoying her new home!

reviews.name: Michael C
reviews.text:
Federal Companies part of Allied Van Lines did an excellent job on our move downsizing from a two story home to a town home ranch. The crew was polite and courteous and very accomdating. They were extra careful and they did not damage any thing on either homes nor damage any thing that they moved for us. Likewise there was no breakage on any housewares items including dishes, glasses, plates, pictures, art items. The crew was truly amazing. To top it off when they moved us it was the hottest day spring/summer thus far when our move occurred. FEDERAL COMPANIES-ALLIED VAN LINES were the most reasonable out of several BREMOVEDsubsidiaries thar we interviewed. Thank you again for a great experience we can't ask for anything better for a married senior couple. It truly was a great experience.
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 06/17/2024

Michael, thank you for trusting us with your big move - we appreciate your business and hope you are enjoying your new home!

reviews.name: Andrew T
reviews.text:
Great communication throughout the entire moving process! All of the staff were very friendly and responsive. I can't highlight enough how important that is to us. We had REMOVEDmove us from California to Illinois, and it was a horrible experience. The move with REMOVEDtook much longer than they told us it would, and no one from the company would communicate with us. Allied/Federal Companies was the complete opposite for our recent move from Illinois to Massachusetts - they delivered our stuff on-time and stayed in communication with us throughout the entire process. I would definitely recommend them!
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 06/06/2024

Andrew, thank you for trusting us with your big move! We're thrilled everything went so well. Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback, we've shared with/recognized our team members involved for their efforts! We hope you are enjoying your new home.

reviews.name: Adam A
reviews.text:
The entire process from start to finish was just what i was looking for. After getting quotes from other companies, Federal was the most flexible and accommodating to our needs. When we first started the plan to move from chicago to denver there were a lot of unknowns. such as when we would need to be picked up, which items we were taking with us and when we were going to be able to move into our new house. Federal gave me all of the options of timing, possible storage before moving in and moving large unique heavy items. They also explained the different costs for each of these steps. Everything went flawless. they were on time, on budget and our items arrived undamaged. Thank you Federal for making a very stressful situation go as smooth as possible. I would not go with any other company for a cross country move like ours.
Federal Warehouse Company

Date: 05/29/2024

complaints.text: This company has repeatedly given me delivery dates and times and can’t even get close to delivering on time. I’ve taken days off work and lost wages because they can’t fulfill their delivery times. It’s not just hours later, it’s days later.
complaints.businessResponse:
We understand your frustration, and agree, you’re absolutely right to expect reliable delivery times.

We take that seriously, and we have not met our own standards on your delivery. That’s on us. While we are actively working to get your items delivered as quickly as possible, we recognize that doesn’t undo the inconvenience.

We will be sure you’re updated with accurate information moving forward—not estimates we can’t stand behind. We are doing everything we can to get this completed and get this resolved.

Thank you for your patience—we know it’s been earned, not given.

complaints.text:
We moved and arrived at new residence in June 10, 2025.

We are due a refund of $311 for overcharge on weight of load.

See attachment of what we paid and email from Federal employee stating refund due.

We have had many emails and calls and no action regarding refund due.
complaints.businessResponse: We sincerely apologize for the delay in your refund.  We will be issuing the refund via check effective immediately today and you should expect within a week depending on USPS delivery.  We do not find this length of time to be acceptable and will work through the process of eliminating these errors on our end.  We thank you for allowing us to provide you our services and sincerely apologize for this delay.  Thank you.

complaints.text:
I moved and lost 20 of my things especially a painting by my husband. The things that were missing were things that they packed up for me. The painting for my husband is very special and important to me. My husband's painting has an image of a lighthouse in the distance. I talked to REMOVED, a rep at the business, about the missing painting and she gave me one of the paintings and wasn't that enough. I have talked to her once a month since August 2024.

I would really like the paintings from my husband given back to me especially the one with the lighthouse in the distance, an Indian painting called the Blue Wire and they are big paintings.
complaints.businessResponse:
We are sorry for the issues with your delivery.  We certainly do not intend to have these issues for our customers.  However, with this issue of a potential missing item reaching one year, the outcome of the item appearing no longer exists.  We simply do not have these items in our possession.  As much as we'd like to provide you with a different outcome, we must continue to inform you that they are not in our possession.

We have been in communication with you since September of 2024 in regards to these items.  You had originally suspected our driver of taking these paintings and properly asked that you file a police report, which was completed.  We did fortunately find one painting and returned that to you.  We have also checked our warehouse several other times since September of 2024 and informed you that they are not in our possession.  We no longer have any of your items in our possession.

Again, we apologize for the issues.

complaints.text:
This company made a delivery to my home and damaged my storm door in June of this year. I have called them weekly since then and have not received a return call from anyone. Only lies, broken promises and now they won't answer my calls at all. I did not pay them directly. They were contracted to make a delivery to me by a company that I did business with.
Customer Answer

Date: 09/14/2024

I would like to have my storm door repaired or replaced

Piled Up, Broken, Not Delivered
If I could give less than 1 star I would. They had stuff piled to the roof in their truck and boxes piled on top of stuff that said "Do not stack" Boxes labeled "This side up" sideways with stuff on top. They're supposed to be final mile "white glove" delivery, however, they never even unboxed the items to check them after the LTL carrier delivered them at their terminal before they brought them to me. They just piled my bedroom set into a truck full of stuff. Imagine if they come back after a new part is received by them and open another box and something else is broken, then do they drive off with my whole order again and I wait again and then we repeat the process? They would only leave my order if I said they could pile it up in my garage in parts until such time as new parts arrived and then they would return and bring it inside and put it together. While I paid 199 for them to bring it in and assemble it, it's important to know that the retailer that sold me the order has also paid a portion of the shipping and it is more than what I paid. This isn't just the 199 delivery fee, its the 3000.00 I paid for the goods they have piled up in their truck with zero care at all that will now ride around with them for the day and sit in some kind of storage until... whenever... My order sat with them for a week because they only deliver to my area Thursdays. Based on what I see they are not careful with things at all and I can't even imagine what else is broken. When you call you get voicemail. I had the retailer I bought my set from on the phone as the truck was driving away while I was still trying to even get a copy of the photo of the broken item. Clearly the supervisor the truck crew was talking to is not qualified to be in his position and a company thay allows this kind of thing to go on doesn't deserve to be in business. They did not take care with my things and did not perform the service I paid for. I will not go away until this is fully resoved to my satisfaction and if I have to go after them with a lawyer I will. I want my stuff checked for damage and delivered and set up as agreed.
complaints.businessResponse:

reviews.text: My name is REMOVED. I am 65 years old and on S.S. For two months I have been looking for a tank for my turtle!!! I found one I could afford on Amazon. I ordered some other things I needed everything was told to me it was paid and would be delivered!!! But they keep telling me my tank could not be shipped it hadn't been paid for . But as I said I was told everything was paid for. They keep changing my account and it went overdraft three times . That's REMOVEDeach time I can't afford!!! They keep not shipping the tank and changing the dates til I finally cancel it !!! I don't have the money these stores want for one so I choose Amazon!!! They lied to me !!! Steal from me and cheated me !!! This turtle belonged to my son who passed away !!! She is all I got of him !!!! The tank has a crack in it I have tried to fix and I really don't want her to get hurt !!! Omg someone for God sake help me get my tank !??

reviews.name: Christopher S
reviews.text: I have tried to reach out to the logistics department and team and have been unable to connect with anyone. I manage a property that consistently has packages taken from it due to delivery personnel leaving packages outside, or in the main lobby as opposed to the package room. All door are equipped with an Amazon Key and it is operable. My previous experience with the logistics department has always been positive in other areas however this team here in REMOVEDis unresponsive and when connecting with an agent I am provided a number that rings once and disconnects starting the process over again. We have signs that clearly depict where packages are to be left (and a bold lettered sign that reads package roomshocking) all other carriers seem to be able to deliver these to the correct location. In the past Amazon would call weekly at my previous properties to ensure delivery instructions for the building itself remained the same as notes are provided to the driver such as access code, Amazon key capable. I would like to be contacted to figure out a solution. We have tracking numbers for packages being left outside of the building and doing our part in the investigation to reduce the amount of stolen packages and deliveries to incorrect locations. Its disheartening to come in everyday to dozens of packages being left on the floor and thrown across the room. We had about 3 blue totes in our lobby the other day 1 filled with packages and 2 empty ones. No attempt made to deliver. My contact is REMOVED. REMOVEDS Assistant Portfolio Manager.

reviews.name: Serena E
reviews.text: I ordered a storage bed that was assembled by a contractor. After one week the handle to lift the bed snapped off. I contacted Amazon to get just the handle replaced. They said all they could do was send a replacement bed. I was not interested in a replacement because I had already paid a contractor to assemble the first one. About six months after purchase the bed would not close properly leaving it lopsided and I was waking up with back problems. I contacted Amazon. They instructed me to contact the insurance. Insurance told me they cant do anything because the purchase was made less than a year ago. They informed me to contact Amazon and the manufacturer. I contacted Amazon they offered a 15% refund. I contacted the manufacturer they offered a replacement. I contacted Amazon again they finally began the return process and told me an Amazon driver would come retrieve the item and I did not need to disassemble the item. I take off a full day of work, wait for said driver just for him to show up and refuse the item. I call back Amazon they say they are sending someone the next day. I take off work again and no one shows up. I call Amazon again they finally book Maersk to pick up the item. REMOVEDpicks it up on July 24. I am calling every week one month after the pick up and still getting the run around on my refund. From the beginning of this process I advised them that the card used to purchase this item is no longer active and requested on several occasions my refund be issued in check form. I call again two weeks ago and a supervisor states she sees the notes on the account that I am requesting a check and she has begun the refund process. A week later nothing. I call again last week just for another supervisor to tell me the refund has not been processed. Again I mention I would like my refund in check form. I wake up to receive an email stating that my refund has been issued to an Amazon gift card. I call in and they say they can not do anything about it.

reviews.name: Anthony B
reviews.text: Lately most of my packages don't show up. When you try to request help from them it's near impossible to speak with anyone and when you do, they're rude and refuse to help whatsoever.

reviews.name: Lisa F
reviews.text: I've been an Amazon member for many, many years. For as long as I can remember, every order I've made, the money has came out of my account instantly (or the put a hold on it till it ships but the money still shows as taken out of my account). I placed an order in September 11, 2026 consisting of 4 items for a total of a little over $40. Yesterday, I received the first notification stating that my order needs payment revision. I contacted customer service (have screenshot showing what I was told) and the representative told me that my card was successfully charged & that my order would ship soon. Then today I get the same notification. Contact customer service again, yet this time, I'm not met with friendly, helpful individuals. I gave them all the information they asked for. They refuse to give me chain of command contact information, the refuse to refund my REMOVEDrefused to ship my order. I absolutely do not recommend Amazon to anybody unless you want your money stole, items kept, and nothing done about it.

reviews.name: mooserist l
reviews.text: I paid $14.99 a month for Amazon prime membership. Yesterday, I purchased several items, all of which stated when I reviewed their shipping, the products would be delivered between 7:30 am and 11:00 am the next day. I had several other items in my cart but they would not be delivered until a later date. I specifically placed those items back to save for later. I was expecting to get the products that were supposed to be delivered the next day. 1 of the items came at 10:00 am today. The other items will be delivered tomorrow. This is the third time this has happened. Be ware of prime membership deception.

reviews.name: Mark R
reviews.text: Amazon is an organized criminal enterprise. They use inadequately programmed AI robotic voices to answer ALL callers trying to fold complaints or resolve problems. The robots don't understand common American English words. Amazon's live operators are in another country and they rarely understand callers due to an inadequate command of the English language. They have no training in active listening or customer service or problem resolution. They refer callers to a website that is user hostile. The chat app is an AI robot programmed to pass the REMOVEDpoint fingers, and provide NO substantive help. Amazon corporate HQ has unlisted numbers. Even the BBB displays a number for them that answers in another country. Amazon has refused to comply with repeated judgements from federal courts brought by the US government. They do not comply with federal laws or BBB best practices for call centers or REMOVEDethical standards. There is NO way to resolve problems with that REMOVEDcompany that pretends to be a legitimate REMOVEDyet has nasty, putrid stinking hatred for American customers, American laws, American court orders, and universal human dignity!

reviews.name: Amanda M
reviews.text: I am executing a claim under the 1-year Amazon Renewed Premium Guarantee for a defective item. Amazon's written policy promises a replacement unit if one is available. The item is currently in stock, but customer service is refusing a replacement. They are forcing a refund-and-rebuy process that forces me to pay an extra $100 due to market inflation. Furthermore, they refuse to release the refund until the item is received. Because I do not have a credit card or cash to float this cost, Amazon's refusal to issue a direct replacement creates severe financial hardship and effectively breaks their binding 1-year warranty contract. I require a corporate manager to manually dispatch the replacement unit at no cost.

reviews.name: Lucas D
reviews.text:
(I was scammed by an amazon seller)September 6th I was searching for an Electric bike i found a great deal at $490 the original price is $1099 I purchased it immediately. After I purchased it i felt uncomfortable so i canceled the order. A little while after that the seller messaged me saying they were out of stock and I could purchase again from another Amazon warehouse. This made me very skeptical so I called to Amazon and spoke to the customer service and explained everything so far I asked her about the seller and the bike price which was more than half off. The customer service REMOVED(i know her name)She assured me the seller was legitimate and the bike price too. I messaged the seller and told them I would like to purchase the bike again. The seller messaged me saying I could purchase it again and they would take off 10% they sent me a fake link which appeared to be Amazon and turned out to be a site called REMOVEDwhere I made this purchase of $410 immediately after I purchased it I realized I was scammed. I contacted amazon.com and I got no help whatsoever. The way they spoke to me was like this happens all the time and they already knew what to say they basically urged me to contact my bank. My bank is Venmo so it's not really a bank I guess anyway I contacted Amazon support, Venmo Support, even that shady site REMOVEDand nobody would help me. These companies are terrible and no help at all if you get ripped off. I lost $410 dollars that is horrible.

complaints.text: On July 14, 2025 I called the Advanced HVAC, the company I have used and trusted for years, when my AC stopped working just before a heat wave was due. They told me my unit was frozen and could not be repaired and set me up with their estimator to look at replacement choices. I called a second company for a second estimate, but before he would give me an estimate he asked if he could have his technician look at the system (a 10 year old Trane) at no cost to me. I agreed and he was able to repair the system in no time at all. He also refused to charge me for said repair because, "You were taken advantage of, and I don't like it." I am a senior citizen and full-time caregiver for my mother, who has dementia. I am sure that they saw the situation and decided to declare my system dead, assuming I would not do my due diligence and that I would be desperate because of the heat that was on the way. I am sickened by their greed and predatory business practices. I sent them a letter outlining what had happened and asking for my money back. (attached) They have made no reply whatsoever. I DO want my money back so that I can send it to the lovely man who fixed my system, but I also want there to be documentation that this company is not one to be trusted.
complaints.businessResponse:
To Whom It May Concern,

We are deeply saddened to learn of the experience one of our long-time clients had with Advanced Heating & Cooling. We value the trust our customers place in us, and it is never our intention for anyone to feel taken advantage of or mistreated.

In this instance, it is clear that we misdiagnosed our customers system. While mistakes do occasionally happen, we take full responsibility for the error and the impact it had. As soon as we were made aware of the concern, we issued a full refund to the customer. We also attempted to reach out with an apology and to offer to correct the situation after we received an email, but we understand that the customer did not wish to hear from us further at that time.

We also want to acknowledge a possible communication issue. Based on the customers description, we believe a letter may have been mailed to us, but unfortunately, we only received the initial email and then a hand-delivered letter just last week. It is possible that some of the frustration came from delays in correspondence, though we cannot confirm if the mailed letter described was ever received.

We care deeply about all of our clients and regret that this customer felt our actions reflected anything less than integrity. Please know that this experience does not reflect the standards or values of our company. We have taken this situation seriously and will use it as an opportunity for additional training and improvement to help ensure it does not happen again.

We sincerely wish this customer the very best and regret that they left feeling disappointed. Advanced Heating & Cooling is committed to honest, fair, and quality service for every customer we serve.

- REMOVED& REMOVED, Inc.

complaints.businessResponse:
Dear Better Business Bureau,
Thank you for reaching out to us again. We understand your frustration regarding the leak in your replacement hose and the recent updates to our warranty policy. I sincerely apologize for the disappointment and inconvenience this situation has caused.
To help clarify, when a replacement product is issued, it remains covered under the warranty timeline of the original purchase date (May 20th, 2025), rather than resetting with the delivery of the replacement item. Because the original purchase occurred a year ago, it falls outside of our current coverage window.
While we completely understand your disappointment regarding the shift from our previous policy to our current 30-day Money-Back Guarantee,these updates were made necessary to standardize our support across all current product lines. We genuinely value your feedback regarding product durability and communication, and I have shared your comments directly with our product development and management teams.
We appreciate your past support and under these circumstances, we unfortunately cannot issue an additional replacement or a refund for this item.
Thank you for your time and understanding.

reviews.name: Bonnie R
reviews.text: Great fast and friendly service! Very dependable and arrived right on time! Super efficient and knowledgeable!

reviews.name: Cameron J
reviews.text: I have a 4 plex with families that have small children. No matter how much or how often I tell them that paper towels, facial tissues, napkins, feminine products, wash cloths, or toys shouldnt go down the toilet because it clogs the pipes and creates gross sewer problems, it inevitably happens. So then, every couple of years, there is a nasty sewage back up. REMOVEDfrom Apollo Plumbing came out and quickly and efficiently cleared the sewer drainpipe and alleviated the disaster. This time it was a combination of feminine products and paper towels. REMOVED. All fixed up under the time and cost budget. I am very happy with the work that Apollo Plumbing and REMOVEDdid getting the clogged sewer pipes back to normal. I will call them the next time I need help, and I recommend that you do as well.

reviews.name: Kat T
reviews.text: Huge shoutout to Apollo Plumbing! We had a leak inside the house that we just couldnt figure out. Water was showing up in our ceiling, but no clue where it was coming from. Super stressful!They got someone out quickly, and the plumber was awesome, super friendly, explained what was going on in a way we could actually understand, and found the leak fast. Turns out it was coming from our shower, and they fixed it without tearing up half the house (which we were honestly expecting at that point).Really impressed with how smooth the whole thing went. Fast, honest, and knew exactly what they were doing. Definitely 5 stars from us!

reviews.name: Debbie L
reviews.text: I had a fantastic experience with Apollo Plumbing when they installed my water heater. From the moment I called, their customer service was top-notch. REMOVEDwas friendly, responsive, and professional. She kept me updated every step of the way, including the arrival time of the technician, which I really appreciated. REMOVEDarrived on time, was very knowledgeable, and completed the installation the same day. Everything was done efficiently and cleanly, and they made sure everything was working perfectly before leaving. I highly recommend Apollo for anyone in need of fast, reliable, and courteous plumbing service. I will definitely use them again in the future!

reviews.name: Jerame J
reviews.text: Absolutely terrible! I had an appointment scheduled with them for two weeks. They called hours before to reschedule from Tuesday to Friday. Friday comes, just again a few hours from my appointment, they call and cancel saying that we are outside of their service area! They had my address the entire time and rescheduled day of, then canceled their rescheduled appointment! Then she had the gall to say check the BBB website for a company in your area! Clearly you told me YOU SERVICED my area if you booked and even rescheduled my appointment! Be warned if you book with them, be prepared to have your appointment canceled underneath your feet after taking off work. 0 stars if I was able to give! Absolutely terrible service!

reviews.name: Jeanne L
reviews.text: Great service, let me know when he was on his way. Very cordial, friendly and showed and explained everything he had done.

reviews.name: William H
reviews.text:
After a severe cold snap in the REMOVED, I, a REMOVED-based landlord, faced a plumbing emergency in my REMOVED, REMOVEDrental property. My tenants were unable to stop a leak due to their unfamiliarity with the main water valve. I recalled a plumbing service from a catchy radio jingle and found Apollo Plumbing online. Despite it being late, they responded promptly to my call, dispatching a plumber who arrived within 10 minutes and quickly managed the situation. The plumber isolated the leak in the attic, where he discovered remnants of an old gravity-fed water system from when the house was built in 1919. He provided not only a REMOVEDbut also a fascinating historical insight into the home's early plumbing. The quote for further repairs was surprisingly reasonable, and the work was completed the next day. I was impressed by Apollo Plumbing's efficient, knowledgeable service and the minimal disruption to my tenants, who were also pleased with the outcome. I highly recommend Apollo Plumbing for their professionalism and reliability.

complaints.text: Demand for Immediate Refund Deceptive Trade Practices Transaction Date: November 26, 2025 Amount Demanded: $900.00 I demand immediate refund of a $900 deposit paid to Apollo Plumbing for services I declined after discovering pricing practices that appear to violate Washington's Consumer Protection Act (RCW 19.86).On November 26, 2025, Apollo provided 3 estimates for the same plumbing issue (small slowly leaking washing machine shut-off valves):Estimate #REMOVED: $1,069.64 (connect supply lines - 15-minute task)Estimate #REMOVED: $1,805.57 (replace valves)Estimate #REMOVED: $6,320.60 (replace washing machine box)Market research with 3 licensed contractors confirms standard pricing for valve replacement at $300-$600. Apollo's pricing represents a 300% markup above prevailing market rates.This tiered pricing structure constitutes price anchoring designed to manipulate consumers into accepting grossly inflated charges. The $6,320 "premium" option makes the $1,805 option appear reasonable when both exceed fair market value .Additionally, Apollo's Terms and Conditions (attached to all estimates) state contractor registration expires "July 9, 2022," raising questions regarding licensing compliance when conducting business in REMOVEDBasis for Refund:Unfair/deceptive acts in commerce (RCW 19.86.020)Pricing inconsistent with reasonable trade standards Possible operation without current contractor registration Demand:Full refund of $900 within 10 business days of this complaint.
complaints.businessResponse:
Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. We take concerns like this seriously and want to clarify a few important points for accuracy and transparency.

First and most importantly, the $900 deposit was fully refunded, as soon as we became aware that you had decided not to proceed with service. The brief delay occurred because the cancellation was submitted via office email over the weekend, when our administrative team was not available to immediately process refunds. At no point was there any intent to withhold funds, and the refund was completed promptly once reviewed.  (The $900 down payment was originally paid on 11/26/2025, it was refunded on 12/2/2025.  A copy of the receipt is attached.)

Regarding pricing, we provide multiple estimate options to reflect different repair scopes, materials, warranty coverage, and long-term solutions. This is not intended to manipulate customers, but rather to allow them to make an informed decision based on their budget and goals. Customers are always free to decline service at any point, as you did. No work was performed, and no charges were retained.

Pricing in professional plumbing is influenced by factors such as licensed labor, insurance, compliance with local codes, warranty liability, and same-day service availability. While market pricing can vary widely, our estimates are designed to reflect the full cost of providing compliant, insured, and warrantied work, not just task duration.

As for the contractor registration date referenced in the terms and conditions, this was a clerical error in the document template, not an indication of expired or inactive licensing. Apollo Plumbing is properly licensed, bonded, and insured to operate in REMOVED, and we have since corrected the document to prevent future confusion.

We regret that this experience caused frustration and appreciate you bringing your concerns to our attention. If you would like to discuss this further or have any remaining questions, our manage

reviews.name: Waz R
reviews.text:
Major billing issues from being charged for appointments that you never had years later, to being charged for relatives that are not minors, to being overcharged and having a credit balance on your account without your knowledge. Also some of the staff members are rude and dishonest. I was contacted about an early replacement appointment because someone cancelled only to get there and the appointment not be available. Staff member named REMOVEDlied just to get me into the building to pay a small bill that they can't prove I owe. No insurance records match the date of service for this mysterious charge. I have no issue paying a bill I actually owe and my history with the company shows so its disappointing to experience this type of treatment. I've asked for a detailed billing statement to verify the accuracy of the account. Billing and customer service needs to be addressed.
Sleep Dentistry of Portland and Vancouver

Date: 04/15/2026

We appreciate the opportunity to address this concern. After reviewing our records, we found that the patients insurance was showing up "inactive" upon us attempting to bill them so they would not accept the claim when we sent it in September of 2023 (patients plan is effective based on the amount of hours worked), patient said that was not correct and asked time to figure it out with his HR so we could re-bill. In good faith we agreed to give patient the opportunity to iron out the insurance on his end. The patient then came in for five more visits, each time he was asked by a staff member if he had contacted his insurance and he said no every time. We let him know that before we proceeded with his next appointment the balance would need to be taken care of. Patient agreed. Our office then left him 6 voicemails over time in regards to his account and it was not until he was offered an earlier appointment time that we were able to get him on the phone and also remind him that the balance would need to be paid upon his arrival. He declined the sooner appointment and opted to keep his original scheduled appointment. Patient then showed up at the office unexpected and the staff believed it was to bring his account current. He was immediately upset and said he did not know about the balance and left.

We strongly disagree with the characterization of our office, our team, and our business practices. We are committed to ethical standards, transparency, and respectful communication, and we take inaccurate or misleading claims seriously.

Our practice has clear policies regarding scheduling, financial responsibility, and insurance coordination. We make consistent, documented efforts to communicate with individuals regarding account questions, including providing detailed explanations and supporting documentation when requested. In situations where a balance persists, we also make good-faith efforts over time to resolve matters, including, when appropriate, extending financial courtesies as a means of closure.

We are also proud of the consistency of our team. The majority of our staff have been with our practice for many years, and we have continued to grow by thoughtfully adding new team membersnot due to high turnover, but to better serve our patients and community.

We take pride in maintaining a professional and respectful environment for both our patients and our staff. Claims regarding dishonesty or misconduct do not reflect the standards we uphold or the expectations we have for our team.

complaints.businessResponse:
We appreciate the opportunity to address this concern. After reviewing our records, we found that the patient contacted our office requesting a copy of his receipt. Our team promptly fulfilled this request and emailed the receipt to the email address provided by the patient on the same day.


Please see the attached documents for proof of the receipt in question being printed on 10-13-2025 at 12:59 and the email confirmation showing the receipt was sent the same day on 10-13-2025 at 1:03.


Its possible there was a misunderstanding or that the message was filtered to a junk or spam folder, which may have led to the perception that we had no record of the patient in our system.


We value all our patients and strive to ensure clear and timely communication. We regret any confusion this situation may have caused and are happy to resend the receipt or provide any additional documentation the patient may need.

Kind regards, 

Codi at Sleep Dentistry of Portland

reviews.text: I booked a reservation directly through the hotels official website and received confirmation through SynXis, their reservation system. Despite this, I was contacted by REMOVED, who identified herself as a manager, and informed that the first night of my stay had been canceled due to overbooking.This was clearly a property error. Instead, REMOVEDrefused to provide any solution and ended the call abruptly. She stated her shift was over at 3:00 p.m. and hung up at 3:03 p.m., leaving us without assistance.This was not the cancellation of an entire weeks stayit was only for one night. Yet rather than correcting their mistake, the hotel chose to cut our reservation and provide no support. This demonstrates a complete lack of service and accountability, which is unacceptable in the hospitality industry.I am requesting acknowledgment of this issue, a formal apology, and assurance that Columbia Hospitality will address this behavior so future guests are not treated the same way.

complaints.text:
I am doing an interstate move with Mayflower moving through Premier Relocations of Michigan. The original quote had storage at destination because high temperatures would be damaging to my shipment. When the quote was turned into a contract that was omitted and they had put storage at destination. I didn't see the change. They shipped the items across country in the high temperatures. I attempted to have the shipment stopped and stored somewhere temperature controlled en route - they refused. They are now storing the items at a facility that has higher temperatures and are refusing to deliver the items for another 2 weeks.

This shipment contains all of our family heirlooms that are very likely to be irreparably damaged by the heat - this includes an antique polar bear, approximately 20 paintings, antique furniture, wine, extensive record collection, electronics, and more. They have had possession of our items since Saturday, July 18th. We have been begging them to assist us and protect our items since Monday, July 20th, when we found out they had been shipped in the high temperatures.

During packing the GM of the moving company had expressed that it was very hard to make a claim on high value items in a way that made me feel I would have no remedy if there were actual damages to high value items. He mentioned that the heat in transit can be really high and I had discussed with him that our items would be stored locally during packing.

Since our items left Michigan en route to Utah, no one has helped us. We keep hearing there is nothing that they can do and the condition of our belongings will continue to deteriorate in the heat. I am pursuing any and all options to have my shipment delivered as soon as possible in the hope that I can minimize further damage.

reviews.text: Over the past few years weve used As You Wish for several major home projects, including a whole-home Generac backup generator installation, HVAC duct cleaning, and replacement of two furnaces. Altogether weve invested around $60,000 with REMOVEDany company handling projects of this size, not everything went perfectly. There were a few issues along the way, but what stood out to me was that they continued working with us and honored their commitment to getting things completed.The technicians who came to our home were consistently professional, knowledgeable, and respectful.Several of them clearly took pride in their work, and that made a lasting impression.I believe reviews should reflect the overall experience rather than expecting perfection. Based on the quality of the work, the people theyve hired, and their willingness to stand behind their services, I would recommend As You Wish to others looking for HVAC or generator installation.

reviews.text: REMOVEDand REMOVEDcame out today to do a tune-up on our heat-pump. While they were here, I asked them to look at a broken light socket that I was worried would cause a fire. reviews.text: Helped place a restraining order against me the domestic violence victim I hired Dellino Law Group (REMOVEDand Michelle Dellino) for family law representation. reviews.name: Bradley P
reviews.text:
This firm is absolutely awful! I retained their services for an arbitration situation due to a discrepancy in my parenting plan. In 2.5 months, the only communication we have had includes two phone calls and a zoom call, each of which resulted in zero work being performed by this firm. The attorney I was provided was REMOVED, she changed her paralegal about half way through, and repeatedly kept citing "Emergency safety issues" (regarding other cases that took priority over mine) for WEEKS while leaving me in the dark until I sent 3-4 emails and calls begging for a response.. I have attempted to reach out to my attorney via email only to get ignored for days on end, I attempted to reach out via phone call only to be sent to a voicemail and never gotten back to, I attempted to call and schedule an appointment, only to be told that the soonest they could schedule an appointment was over a week out... They charged me absurd onboarding fees totaling around $850, after charging me almost $500 for my initial hour long consultation!... By the end of 2.5 months, my patience was gone and I have paid well over $3,000 and have not seen any work come out of this firm. When I attempted to withdrawal, the attorney completely glossed over my demand to close my case, and attempt to actually make progress, but did a half-a$$ job and couldn't even input details that I had already provided to them in writing, expecting me to do their work for them and fill in the blank sections.. BEWARE THIS FIRM AND DO NOT TRUST THEM WITH YOUR MONEY OR YOUR TIME-SENSITIVE SITUATION!! THEY DON'T CARE ABOUT YOU!! I could go on and on about how horrible this firm is and how little they cared about assisting me and only cared about taking more and more of my money without performing the service I was being charged for, but at the end of the day, I just needed to walk away and find someone who would actually put effort into my case.
Dellino Law Group, PLLC

Date: 10/17/2025

reviews.text:
I contacted this law firm due to an ongoing neighbor dispute. My neighbor is a racist, bigot who constantly attacks me and my husband who has a hearing loss. When I attempted to get an appointment scheduled with my lawyer, I couldnt get them to prioritize my schedule. I called my attorney out and she behaved like an immature child. Shes emotionally immature and certainly doesnt have your stressful situation prioritized. I will be back to upload transcript photos of my attorney improperly using my neighbor against me to seek an order against me because she couldnt do her job. If you want to experience a less stressful situation use an LGBTQ attorney or a black female lawyer. These people have a complicated history with the law and are better suited for marginalized communities. Dellino is awful.

reviews.text:
I initially took my car in for a simple bumper repair, which was supposed to take 8 days. The day after I dropped it off, the shop called to report additional damage. This new discovery extended the repair timeline to a month due to the time needed to source parts.When I requested that they proceed with just the originally planned repairs, I was informed that disassembly had damaged other parts, making reassembly impossible without the new parts. The shop claimed such damage occurs "100% of the time." The representative bluntly stated, Look, Im not going to argue with you. You can get a tow truck and pick up the pieces of your car, or you can wait a month.Additionally, the shop asked about my insurance and instructed me to have my case transferred to a specific adjuster they preferred working with. They warned it might require up to a dozen calls to manage this, which I found REMOVEDburdensome and strange.Once this adjuster took over, coinciding with the discovery of the additional damage, the repair estimate increased dramatically. This manipulation of the insurance process and the sudden escalation of costs made me highly uncomfortable and raised suspicions about their motives.I attempted to discuss these issues further by calling to speak with a manager on two separate occasions. Unfortunately, the manager was never available and did not return my calls.The overall experience left me feeling frustrated and powerless, especially given the threat to leave my car in pieces unless I complied with their extended timeline. This has been an extremely disheartening and dissatisfying ordeal.

reviews.name: Julie B
reviews.text: We booked an international trip not realizing that our passports had to be valid for at least three months beyond our date of departure from the country we were visiting. With departure less than 30 days away (and a cruise scheduled during those 30 days) I was a bit panicked. I found Allstate via an online search and while I was a bit nervous about it, I decided to try it based on the 100 percent positive reviews on the BBB website. So very glad I did! The process could not have been more seamless. I paid for 10 business day return service and had the passports back including all shipping time in 9 days including two weekends. The website instructions were very straightforward. I received status emails every step of the way. I even received an email on Sunday after shipping the package on Saturday to request the REMOVEDtracking number so they could follow it for receipt. I can't speak for their other services but if you need a passport renewed quickly, I highly recommend Allstate. What a pleasure to do business with a company that actually meets (and exceeds) expectations!!

reviews.text:

I chose to go with Allstate and they exceeded my expectations. I requested the expedited renewal (15 business days), and followed their clear instructions on their website. I also got emails when the file was completed and when my renewed passport was sent to me with proper tracking codes via REMOVEDI got my new passport in about 10 calendar days. Over all it was a smooth, seamless process and I highly recommend them if you want to be assured of reliable, efficient and top notch passport renewal process.

reviews.name: Rene B
reviews.text:
Beware of these fake crooked people. Even their insurance is fake. They lost of stole 10000 dollars of our household goods.
Do not use this company. We were overcharged fleeced scammed

reviews.name: Barbara E
reviews.text: I contracted with this company to move my things from Arizona to my new home in North Carolina. My first day of availability to receive my things was May 15th. I still don't have my things after I've been told 3 times now that the van is being loaded. Phyllis from customer service FINALLY returned the numerous messages I've left and told me "I'm no longer with the company but I'm trying to help you get your things". I have no idea if this is even the truth or if I'll ever see my things again. This has been horrific treatment and I am physically sick about this.

reviews.name: Richard B
reviews.text: Don't believe the Binding Moving Estimate they provide. We gave them a complete inventory and they estimated $12,705. The final cost came in at over $24,860. Once they have your items, you don't have any choice but to pay them to get them delivered. Phyllis tried to blame the difference on an employee they fired, but he wasn't the person who prepared our estimate.

reviews.name: Rachelle N
reviews.text:
Do not trust this company. Not even a little!!!
United Region Van Lines took one of the most stressful experiences of our lives and turned it into an absolute nightmare. I want to save anyone reading this from making the same mistake we did.
The sales rep quoted us $9,973 for a full Colorado-to-Massachusetts move after a video walkthrough of our entire home. He pressured us to sign on December 31st with a "year-end discount expiring today." That urgency was manufactured. The low quote was a lie.
Charges piled on at every turn: items deliberately left off the list, a surprise treadmill surcharge on moving day, a $1,213 "recalculation" the week before, and a $3,000 shuttle fee buried in the fine print. By the end, our bill was $19,808, nearly double what we were promised! When I refused to pay, the mover asked what he should take off the truck. We were moving across the country. There was nothing to leave behind. They knew that. We were forced to pay 60% in cash and money orders just to guarantee our belongings would be delivered at all.
Delivery took 28 days when the contract says 0-17 days. We sat in our new home in Massachusetts for a month with no furniture, no beds, no kitchen, nothing but what fit in our SUV. No apology. No compensation.
When our stuff finally arrived, boxes were crushed and multiple items were broken. Worst of all, they lost our children's growth stick, every height marked from birth to today. Gone. After weeks of a grueling claims process, they offered us $86. And they had the audacity to attach a non-disparagement agreement to that offer, requiring us to stay silent in exchange. We refused.
When I called to complain on moving day, a rep told me I "shouldn't always trust people." That is who you are dealing with. STAY AWAY! This company should not be in business, they are the worst.

reviews.name: Greg D
reviews.text:
I would give -10 if possible. Stay away from this company. they bait and switch but worse yet, they do not handle your household goods with the care that is warranted for a $36k move. They packed, stored and moved.
The damage that resulted in our move was terrible. Broken items, damaged items, missing items and damage to both our home we moved out of and new home we moved into.
Any group would be better than these folks.
Then to top it off, the "insurance" through them is a joke. Submitted pictures, websites to find items along with the pounds of products along with replacement cost, well over $5,000 and what did they offer as a "fair" settlement?
..."THE SETTLEMENT OF THIS CLAIM HAS BEEN FOUND TO BE IN THE AMOUNT OF $139.00."
I can not stress enough, save yourself a headache and stress. Go with anyone else. You have been warned.... See pictures of just a few examples of how they will treat you...

reviews.name: Mary D
reviews.text:
I contacted United Regions in May for a possible move from Arizona to Tennessee. I was putting my house up for sale then. “Conner” told me to give him a deposit of $2200 to secure “winter rates” which are cheaper than summer rates. So I did
give him the money.
Then housing sales were bad and I could see that I was not going to sell at that time so I took the house off the market. I then requested my deposit back. But they won’t give it back. It’s September and I still don’t have my money I gave them. They did nothing and kept my money. I am a senior woman. I have no way to replace it. It’s all I have now. How could have done this to me?

reviews.name: Susan H
reviews.text: I am disappointed with my experience relocating w/United Regions Van Lines. The initial quote of approx $17k jumped to over $25k because the company grossly underestimated the cu footage, which increased from 1915 to 2850. By the time I realized the costs were outrageous, canceling meant losing money. Communication was terrible. I had to constantly call customer service just to find out if my items were shipped. I was told no, then I finally received a call 5 minutes later that my furniture would be delivered the next day. Having moved over 2400 miles, they had no idea know where my belongings were. My delivery was scheduled the day after a federal holiday; banks were closed. When the driver arrived early the next day, he refused to unload until being paid in full. Customer service berated me for not having $8k+ in cash ahead of time due to a possible discount. The packing was scheduled for 2 days but the movers did not arrive on Day 1. After waiting for hours, I contacted them and was told that they would arrive the next day. Due to the missed day, items were packed hastily with fragile items placed in boxes w/o proper protection like bubble wrap. As a result many items were damaged/destroyed. I also noticed that several items from the garage are missing. I was appalled at the amount of damage. Most of my wood & antique furniture was damaged, including my mother's desk which was broken in many places (the driver tried pounding it with his fists to fix it). The moving company claims my furniture damage was done prior to loading. I have before & after pictures that contradict this. Other belongings were shattered (musical clock & dishes), one-of-a-kind vase, 5 lamps, all my beds had scratches & pieces literally broken off. The list continues; it is devastating. Damages totaled over $18k. The company initially offered $75 in compensation, then $125 after I disputed it-an insult. This company lures customers with low estimates, then slams them with unexpected charges.

reviews.name: Kirsten H
reviews.text: This company refuses to accept personal checks, credit cards or any other payment than cash or a postal service check. They arrived late to load and had my elderly mother standing outside at 1am giving $5000 cash to strangers on the street. All they can say is it's their policy so all I can say is stay as far away from these shady, unprofessional bozos as you can. They have charged more than they said, didn't complete the packing, and do business like it's 1925 not 2025. At least my mom took photos and had witnesses for the exchange of cash and they better believe that if anything else goes wrong we won't ignore it. All she got was a handwritten receipt. Whoever runs this company should give it up or learn how to do business in a way that doesn't put customers at risk. You are shady AF.

reviews.name: Steve F
reviews.text: My fianc and I have moved all across the country several times over the last 30 years and this is by far the worst company we have ever dealt with. Once we signed and paid the initial deposit of $2,550 (by check or receive an additional 6% charge by CC), we were not contacted again until 2 days before the deadline to cancel at which time they again reviewed our inventory over the phone. Mind you, the phone system seems to work great outbound, but inbound calls, Good Luck!The original inventory list that we emailed to our "Senior Relocation Specialist" (REMOVED.) in a PDF file was not used and this was confirmed by REMOVEDover the phone. They neglected to add our headboards, baseboards, side rails, an entire bedroom set, BBQ, had the dining room table listed as small even though they had the 8 chairs that were associated with it which would indicate a large dining room table! You can only guess what happened next, right? The quoted amount of $9,966 went up to $12,877,16 due to the additional space required for the move. At this point, the invoice was in question and being disputed without a resolution that they prolonged for 2 days moving me past their 7 day refund window.* REMOVEDDon't use them!* Always problems with their phone system.* Whatever you ask of them requires a supervisors approval, but you can never get in touch with anybody other than REMOVEDwho is always "to busy" to assist over the phone.* They make it seem like they are doing you a favor by "going into the office" or "getting out of bed". And yes, they did say this!Well, I'm here to tell you this company will do the exact thing we all fear. They'll take your money and leave you stranded!Quote you one price, increase it before the move date and IMO, would have increased it again after pick up or before delivery.What a joke! In short and REMOVED, DO NOT use this company or you'll be taken for a very unpleasant ride and more than likely lose your deposit and possibly more!

reviews.name: Donna M
reviews.text:
Roman (from Sacramento) and his Team ACED my move. They arrived on time and went right to work. NON stop!!! They were extremely diligent, respectful of my property and finished up the job with no issues. Each of them were very courteous and answered all my questions. Their professionalism was beyond reproach. I'm headed to South Carolina knowing my property is in good hands
!!UPDATE!!
I want to make it clear. The above info regarding the actual packing was done very professionally.
Took a while to post, but my conscience told me to write an update. I'm here in my new state (SC). The "move" was disasterous. I'm just gonna say RUN RUN RUN WAY FROM THE THIEVES - UNITED REGIONS. Don't believe any of the Consumer Affairs "5 star reviews".
United Regions is not even BBB accredited, with numerous complaints, all the same topic.

complaints.businessResponse:
United Regions Van Lines understands that moving can be a stressful process, especially when customers have concerns regarding scheduling, delivery timelines, inventory, or claims. For the benefit of current and future customers, we believe it is important to clarify how our company operates and how these matters are handled.
All services provided by United Regions Van Lines are performed in accordance with company policy, the signed moving agreement, and applicable REMOVEDregulations. Prior to loading, customers are provided with the applicable terms, including the estimated delivery window, which is clearly stated as 017 business days. While customers may provide a first available delivery date, that date does not guarantee delivery on that exact day; it begins the delivery window outlined in the agreement.
United Regions Van Lines also follows a documented inventory process at pickup and delivery. If a customer reports missing or damaged items, the matter must be handled through the formal claims process, which is the proper procedure for review and resolution under federal moving regulations. Settlement determinations are based on the valuation coverage selected in the contract and the documentation provided during the claims process.
Regarding pricing and service terms, United Regions Van Lines operates with transparency. Charges are based on the space used in the truck, measured by cubic footage, and any revised estimate or additional service charge must be reviewed and signed before services are performed. Our team is trained to communicate charges prior to loading and to ensure that customers understand the terms of service before proceeding.
United Regions Van Lines remains committed to professionalism, accountability, and proper handling of customer concerns. Any customer seeking further clarification regarding their move, delivery window, inventory, or claim should call the office so the matter can be reviewed through the appropriate channels.
Sincerely,

complaints.businessResponse:
United Regions Van Lines disputes the characterization of this complaint and the stated disputed amount.
Billing clarification
The customer alleges a disputed amount of $17,000.00 and is requesting a full refund. This figure is inaccurate and unsupported by the billing records.
The total amount actually paid by the customer for this move was approximately $14,600, which covered the transportation services rendered in accordance with the signed estimate, revised estimate (if applicable), and Bill of Lading. At no point did the customer remit $17,000, nor was such an amount charged.
Allegation of holding goods hostage
United Regions Van Lines does not withhold shipments unlawfully. Federal regulations require that balances due under a signed contract be paid prior to release of goods. Any payment requested was strictly in accordance with the contractual terms agreed to by the customer and REMOVEDregulations. There were no threats or improper collection practices.
Pricing
Charges were based on the documented inventory, cubic footage, and services provided. The customer approved the applicable paperwork prior to service. Disagreement with the final cost does not invalidate a signed agreement nor justify a refund of amounts not paid.
Position
Because:
the disputed amount claimed ($17,000) exceeds what was actually paid,
services were performed as contracted, and
no evidence of billing impropriety has been provided,
United Regions Van Lines does not agree that a refund is warranted.
We respectfully request that this complaint be recorded as answered, as the allegations do not align with the documented facts of the transaction.
Sincerely,
Customer REMOVEDstart="2063" data-end="2066">United Regions Van Lines

complaints.text: On Oct 30, 2025 I talked with REMOVEDand scheduled tentative move date if financing went through on sale of home. She indicated no problem, if date changes, just call them back and reschedule. I was charged $2884.00 as a deposit of an estimated price of $8352.07, which is 25% of estimate. Financing fell through and I emailed to change move date on Nov 4, 2025. Financing again fell through and I contacted company to cancel move and requested refund of deposit. complaints.businessResponse:
We would like to clarify the facts of this situation for anyone reading.
The reservation made on October 30, 2025 was not a casual tentative hold. A binding reservation agreement was executed, and a 25% deposit was collected in accordance with the signed contract to secure availability, staffing, and logistics for the requested move window.
When the customer requested changes due to financing issues, the move was rescheduled and held within the cancellation window, meaning the booking remained active and resources continued to be reserved on the customers behalf. The subsequent cancellation occurred outside of the contractually allowed refund period, which was clearly disclosed and acknowledged at the time of booking.
As outlined in the signed agreement:
Deposits are applied toward administrative costs and reservation of services.
Cancellations outside the stipulated timeframe are not eligible for a full deposit refund, regardless of whether the move ultimately takes place.
No services were performed because the customer chose to cancel; however, services were reserved, scheduled, and held, which is precisely what the deposit covers. This policy was reviewed and confirmed by both customer service and management and is applied consistently to all customers.
We encourage future customers to carefully review cancellation terms before submitting a deposit and to contact our office with any questions prior to booking.
Sincerely,

complaints.businessResponse:
Were sorry to hear you feel this way. However, several statements in this review do not match how interstate household-goods moves are documented and handled under DOT/FMCSA rules, and we want to clarify the record for anyone reading.
Delivery timing
Your First Available Delivery Date (FAD) was 08/20/2025 and delivery occurred 09/26/2025. That is approximately 28 business days (27 if excluding Labor Day). While this is beyond our estimated 017 business-day window, it remains within the contractually allowable interstate delivery timeframe of up to 30 business days under federal guidelines.
Communication
Our internal notes show contact activity on 09/15/2025 (message left) and 09/15/2025 (load approved). If you did not receive updates as expected, we understand the frustration, but the file reflects ongoing handling and dispatch statusnot abandonment of the shipment.
Inventory and missing items
REMOVEDmove is governed by inventory and delivery paperwork. If you believe items are missing, that must be addressed through the formal claim/shortage process tied to the inventory. If you did not receive copies at delivery, you can call our office and we will provide the applicable paperwork associated with your job.
Claims and settlement amounts
Claims are administered through an independent claims administrator, and settlement offers are calculated based on the valuation coverage selected at booking (the standard released valuation option is $0.60 per pound per article unless a higher option is selected). That valuation level directly impacts the settlement calculation, regardless of the personal value of the items claimed.
We are not able to validate the specifics of your shipment, paperwork, or claim status from a public post alone. Please call our office with your job number so we can pull the file, confirm the delivery documents, and ensure you are routed through the correct claims resolution channel.
Sincerely, REMOVEDTeam,
REMOVED.

I have attempted to resolve this dispute with H&R Block for the past 6 months. The local branch manager agrees with me that my mother should have received the refund, and the law is clear she was entitled to the refund.
