complaints.text:
Rental application Ref #REMOVED/21054677 at REMOVEDat REMOVED(REMOVED, REMOVED), an REMOVEDMy wife and I paid $475 in application and administrative fees.June 27: ResidentVerify, REMOVED's screening vendor, retrieved my credit (22:15:17 UTC). June 28: Denial issued. The written reason on both the email and the adverse action letter is Credit.Despite this, the property and ResidentVerify told us the issue was a $600 rental collection balance and that submitting proof of payment would satisfy it so the application could be reopened. That balance was paid in full before we ever applied; the bureaus had not yet updated.We submitted the paid-in-full receipt as instructed. It was rejected solely because it did not display my wife's name, despite documenting full payment. My wife then called ResidentVerify and was told our result was "passed with conditions."July 6: Relying on that, my wife visited the leasing office and agent REMOVEDsubmitted a manual review ticket. July 7: A second denial was issued, a duplicate of the first: same reason (Credit), same letter, generated from the identical June 27 retrieval with the same timestamp to the second. No new review occurred.Per REMOVED's own FAQ, a Credit denial is remedied by adding a co-applicant, not by paying a balance. We were directed for a week through a process that could not change the outcome while being told verbally we had conditionally passed. No human is reachable: the office and leasing lines route every call to an automated AI agent, the corporate line REMOVED) cannot take calls, and the Specialized Applications team REMOVED) never returned my wife's voicemail or email sent during business hours.
Customer Answer

Date: 07/09/2026

Please see attached

We lived in REMOVEDfor 3 years before we started having problems. In July of 2024 are air conditioning unit quit working. It took over 3 weeks to repair and once repaired there was a giant hole in our wall for over 6 months. You could see the sunlight from outside which meant critters could get in. The bathroom in the main bathroom was flooded 3 times from the apartment above us which led to mold. (I have pictures of all of this, but it will not let me upload on here). They lied about when they said they changed the air filter and finally did come up after my husband who recently had a kidney transplant and is on immune suppressant drugs got violently ill. They painted over the mold only for the mold to return. I have messages telling us we could leave the lease early, yet they are still trying to charge us.We were charged monthly pest fees, and they only sprayed 2 times a year. We had a cockroach infestation, and it took begging to get them to do anything. I have reached out several times to talk to someone in charge about these issues only to not have messages returned.
complaints.businessResponse:
Thank you for reaching out. Our team has reviewed our documentation and please see a summary of our findings:

REMOVED
- The complaint states the air conditioning failed in July 2024 and took over three weeks to repair. Our records reflect that this occurred in July 2025, not 2024.
- On July 2, 2025, you submitted a work order stating the air conditioner was not cooling properly but advised you were out of town. Upon inspection, the unit was operating within normal parameters, maintaining an interior temperature of approximately 74 degrees despite extreme outdoor temperatures. 

-On July 8, 2025, you reported the unit was no longer functioning properly. At that time, our maintenance team determined that, due to the age of the equipment, replacement was necessary. A portable air conditioning unit was immediately provided while the replacement was scheduled. Because you worked from home and requested accommodations, the installation was coordinated around your availability.

- The REMOVEDunit was replaced on July 14, 2025.

- The "large hole" in the wall. was the opening referenced is the manufacturer's exterior ventilation grille required for the operation of the through-the-wall REMOVEDunit. This grille is a normal component of the system and is designed to prevent animals or pests from entering the apartment.


Mildew/Mold Concerns

- Our records reflect one maintenance request regarding mildew in April 2026, specifically within the water heater closetnot the bathroom as stated in the complaint.

Upon inspection:
- Only minimal surface mildew was observed.
- The area was cleaned using an appropriate antimicrobial cleaner.
- Moisture readings throughout the apartment were taken and found to be within normal limits.
- Maintenance monitored the area from April 28 through May 5, 2026, with no recurring moisture or mildew identified.

Kitchen Ceiling
- You also reference the mold in the kitchen ceiling. Our records show the ceiling's popcorn texture had begun peeling.

reviews.text:
This feedback regarding the completely unsatisfactory and frankly insulting denial of my dispute. The Core Failure: No Service Rendered, Period.The merchant (Agoda) failed to confirm the booking, which means I received absolutely zero service or product for the $143.08 charged.I was provided with an email from the merchant: "We're sorry, the booking you attempted to make recently was not completed Agoda is unable to confirm your booking." I was charged for a product that literally did not exist.The Incompetence of the Investigation The denial states that the merchant provided "compelling evidence" and that the service was "cancelled in accordance with the merchant's disclosed cancellation and refund policy."1. By blindly accepting their policy, your investigation failed to recognize the critical difference between a customer cancelling a confirmed trip and the merchant failing to deliver the product they charged for.2. Dismissal of Customer Evidence: The most infuriating part of this process is the claim by your associate that my screenshot of the merchant's emailthe very document proving their failure to confirmwas deemed "not valid." This is an outrageous and baseless dismissal of factual evidence provided by the very company that issued the charge. You are effectively calling a merchant's own system-generated notification invalid when it supports the customer's claim.Your institution chose to hide behind the vague excuse of "altering contractual agreements" instead of engaging in critical thinking. There was no contract to alter, as the merchant themselves stated the booking was unconfirmed.

reviews.text:
The salesperson who came to my office lovebombed me, telling me how much people need my services, how she would like to hire me herself, and how she'd like to share my work with her church group. It seemed sincere, but the look on her face as she walked out the door told me otherwise. I could not locate her contact information or remember the company name so I waited to hear from her. The next point of contact was a receipt sent to me two days after my first ad deadline. Finally, her email address and name! I emailed her and asked where she had been. She told me that since I was moving my business, she did not want to disturb me. What business professional in a new professional relationship actually does that? She that day sent me an awful mockup of an advertisement and cited that they gave me a deadline extension. I have a degree in Fine Art and this work a 4th grader could have done. Fortunately, I just received a professionally created ad which I sent to her for comparison. She acknowledged my grievances but I'm quite concerned about the lack of integrity, the poor quality work (I dropped what I was doing to give her edits but it's still a very poor representation of my business brand), and the lack of flexibility on the company's part. I'm a small business owner and a woman and I work hard for my income, in a helping profession. When I finally got an email from the company, I was thanked and told my rates were 'locked in' for the remainder of the contract. So very disappointing. Do not use this company.

complaints.text: I entered into a 36-month advertising agreement with Best Version Media for REMOVED. I am filing this complaint because I believe BVM failed to provide services as represented, billed me for services that were not properly delivered, and is now refusing cancellation despite documented service failures.This is not about lack of advertising results. BVM acknowledged that my August print placement was missed and stated that a make-good was applied. BVM also acknowledged website-related issues by applying website credits for later months. The website was poorly executed, did not properly represent my business, and multiple edit requests were overlooked, unresolved, or repeatedly mishandled.I also requested proof that the publication was actually distributed as represented, specifically for the Greenfield Hill issue, including REMOVEDreceipts, mailing records, route records, print-run documentation, and the number of homes actually mailed to. BVM has not provided viable proof that the contracted distribution matched what was REMOVEDsigning, I expressed concern about being locked into a long-term contract. BVM representative REMOVEDtold me that if I was unhappy, the situation would be remedied. Now, despite acknowledged service failures, BVM refuses cancellation and offers only continued-service options.I have seen numerous public complaints against BVM involving similar issues: long-term contracts, refusal to cancel, billing disputes, alleged misrepresentation, and complaints describing the companys contract practices as predatory or trapping small businesses.Desired resolution: immediate cancellation of the agreement, no further billing, no collections activity, no negative reporting, written confirmation that the account is closed with no further obligation, and documentation proving actual performance/distribution of the advertising services.

complaints.text: August 19, 2026 When I was approached by the sales representative at BVM, It was not obvious from the beginning what was being advertised to me. She showed me their plans and offered to start me out with a monthly payment of $319 for the promise of advertisement and marketing assistance. I felt like from the beginning she was very adamant about us working together and kept offering all these deals and free add ons. Now after reviewing the terms of the contract and agreement I feel I was taken advantage of and not clearly explained the agreement. There is no cancellation on the contract and an expectation that you will pay more money than what was agreed upon in the contract. They shove the signature spot in your face before you have time to truly understand what it is youre signing, and it was my mistake for agreeing with the plan she had discussed with me without asking questions first, but I feel very misled and want to cancel my partnership with this company before it begins.
complaints.businessResponse: We are pleased to share that we worked with our client to swiftly resolve this matter and mutually part ways. We wish our client the best of luck moving forward.

complaints.text: I entered into a three-year advertising contract with BVM 11/25 after feeling heavily pressured by the salesperson. I did not want to commit to a three-year agreement, but I was repeatedly encouraged to do so. I was told to give the advertising approximately two months before I should expect to see results. Based on those representations, I moved forward and instructed my staff to carefully screen all new clients and leads so we could determine whether BVM was generating business for my salon.After approximately 6.5 months, I had seen no meaningful return whatsoever. During that entire period, I had essentially no communication from my salesperson. The only contact I received was from his wife, who contacted me in an unprofessional manner accusing me of not paying my bill, despite the fact that I had fully paid what I owed.I eventually contacted my salesperson and explained that I was receiving no return from the advertising. He told me that he would give me a three-month break. I understood this to mean that I would receive three months of relief from the contract and payments. I later discovered that what he actually meant was that the three months would simply be added to the end of my contract. I believe this was extremely misleading and not what was represented to me during our conversation.I was then referred to a special client correspondent and was told that I needed to sign an REMOVED, that I could not sue the company, and that I would remain liable for the remainder of the contract. In my experience, the company did not honor the understanding I was given verbally, and I felt completely tricked and REMOVEDthis point, I have paid approximately $4,000 for advertising that produced no meaningful return, and BVM is now attempting to send me to collections for approximately another $14,000. I am extremely distressed by this situation. I entered into this agreement believing the representations made to me by the salesperson.
complaints.businessResponse: Our client agreed to participate as an Expert Contributor, a position that requires a three-year advertising commitment, and the terms of that commitment were included in the signed agreement. When concerns arose, our team offered options to provide flexibility, including a temporary pause while our client focused on hiring additional employees; however, the amendment necessary to implement that option was not completed. Our local REMOVEDalso offered to work directly with our client to refresh their advertising, strengthen the call to action, and develop additional content to improve visibility and engagement. We later proposed an additional resolution to bring the matter to a fair conclusion and invited our client to contact us with any questions or concerns regarding that proposal. We did not receive a response to that outreach. While we understand our clients disappointment with the results, we believe we have acted in good faith, honored the terms of the agreement, and made reasonable efforts to address their concerns and reach a mutually agreeable solution.

complaints.text: I signed up for a magazine with a local representative who talked a big game REMOVED, this was mismanaged from the beginning, Ads were not done right poor communication or no communication she holds networking events so everyone meets people, but she does a poor job at getting you recognized, all these promises are lies, she does nothing for your online presence, then nothing for any thing, she has a rotating door of people, and now since I argued with her about the lack of support and did not pay they are suing me for $51,000, I am taking this to the news media the other local magazines so I can share with them, their corporate needs to investigate this lady!

complaints.text: Best version media contacted me for advertising my business within a local area and promised results in the way of calls and messages of REMOVEDwanting to hire and those looking for my services. complaints.businessResponse: We take client satisfaction seriously and have worked closely with our client throughout their campaign. When the client expressed disappointment with their results, our Digital Team reached out multiple times to offer optimization strategies and dashboard support, but our client missed the scheduled meeting. We also offered customer loyalty upgrades and a complimentary feature article, though the necessary questionnaire was never returned. When the client still requested to cancel, we successfully assigned their remaining contract term to another advertiser, allowing them to exit early with their final ad running in the August 2026 edition. While we do not guarantee specific lead volumes or ROI, we believe our team made every effort to support, accommodate, and fairly resolve this account.

complaints.text: I am the owner of REMOVED. Best Version Media (BVM) signed a contract with me to provide local advertising tied to 1926 Neighbours of REMOVEDin REMOVED, REMOVED. I specifically chose this product because it was marketed as hyperlocal advertising to reach residents in my immediate area.However, BVMs own campaign data later showed that the majority of my digital ads were not served in REMOVEDat all. Only a small portion of impressions were on Canadian inventory, and none were tied by their data to REMOVED. A significant share of impressions were delivered on foreign or non-local inventory, including REMOVEDand REMOVEDapp stores and news sites from other countries. The rest were on generic .com and app-store placements that were not linked to any clear local REMOVEDother words, while I was sold local REMOVED/REMOVEDadvertising, BVM actually ran my ads on a large amount of non-local and foreign inventory that could not reasonably generate local inquiries for my small paralegal practice. Their separate geographic report simply labelled the campaign as Ontario, which is misleading when their own domain-level data shows placements outside my local area.When I raised these concerns, I felt dismissed and blamed. They suggested I was misinterpreting their data and minimized my concerns by pointing to one portion of the package instead of addressing the overall mis-targeting and the fact that the ads were not truly local to REMOVEDas represented. I had already paid approximately $10,000 by this point and felt treated as though my concerns and evidence did not matter.I am filing this complaint because I believe BVMs marketing of this product as local does not match how the ads were actually delivered, and because of the way my concerns were handled after I brought these issues to their attention.
complaints.businessResponse:
We take every client concern seriously and are sorry to hear our client remains dissatisfied. Throughout our partnership, our team made repeated efforts to answer our client's questions, review campaign performance, and work collaboratively to address their concerns. We also provided detailed reporting and explanations regarding the campaign, including how geographic targeting and reporting work. Although our client ultimately stopped making payments under the agreement, our team has continued to make every reasonable effort to address their concerns and work toward a resolution.

reviews.text:
After being a Verizon Connect Customer for about 10 Years, I decided to cancel my sevice. I did so accoridng to their terms and conditions, 60 days prior to the renewal of the term which would automatically renew for 1 year if left uncancelled.For the past 9 months I have been going back and forth with them, FIGHTING about the cancellation. 11/14/25, called to cancel - 1/15 got another bill, called and told it was cancelled. Verizon Connect people confirmed it.On 4/8/26, my card was still being charged. I disuputed the charge and finally was able to speak to a supervisor and received 2 case numbers.Finally on 4/17/26 I received a DocuSign confirming the cancellation. I signed it and thought this was done. It was REMOVEDon 7/7/26 I get a Past Due bll and threats of Collection. Spoke with REMOVED. Finally spoke to a man named REMOVEDwho actually knows what hes doing. We discussed it and he tells me the charges were from January to April. I said "you just made my point, it should have been done in January"Finally agreed and told me he will put in for the credit and update me in 3 days. I've heard this story before so we will have to wait and see if what he said is true. I have now a 3rd case REMOVEDforewarned, if you sign up, be sure you understand contracts and how to cancel them. Be sure to document your cancellation process. Be sure to get case numbers and who you spoke to. It shouldn't be like this...for a company liek Verizon, you shouldn't feel like you're dealing with a scam company.
Verizon Connect

Date: 07/08/2026

Thank you for taking the time to share your feedback. Please accept our sincerest apologies for the extended delay and the immense frustration you experienced while trying to finalize your cancellation. Serving as a Verizon Connect customer for 10 years is a milestone we deeply value, and it is incredibly disheartening to hear that your departure was met with such a prolonged and exhausting ordeal. It is always our primary goal to resolve customer issues quickly, efficiently, and transparently. In your case, we clearly fell short of that standard. We are internally tracking your third and final case number to ensure the credit is processed exactly as promised. We wish you nothing but the best in your future business endeavors.

reviews.text: I signed up for Verizon cellular, Fios internet and TV streaming services in December.l 2025. I was never able to get the streaming set up at all. The fios internet dropped every day. The phone service is in the house was so poor that I did not get the frequent text message codes required to prove my identity when I called them. The number they gave me to set up the online account was not recognized. Finally in January 2026, I gave up after failing to get anything to work with 3 very long phone calls. I tried to cancel all 3 services. They demanded that I pay for 2 months of services. I went into a Verizon store to cancel in person. Then I took the fios equipment back within 2 weeks. The cancellation did not work. I had to call again (and was charge 99cents for the call). Then I received another bill this month, which they say is from Fios because they charge 30 days at a time and I called to cancel 5 days into the next cycle. In the old days, a company that deliver poor service would cancel the bill. Instead, I am out 2 months of services which did not work. Now I am back on REMOVED(while not perfect, at least T-Mobile internet only drops me a few times per month). Never sign up with Fios or Verizon. The only service that seems to work is their billing department.

reviews.name: BRENNON H
reviews.text: Long story short on March 28th, I got an offer to trade in my Iphone 15 pro to receive the 17pro and my phone bill would drop from $119 a month to $104 a month. I created a chat with an agent on the 28th of March that I'm sure you guys have access to, verifying the information, and had gotten her manager involved in the situation. Later that day, I ended up taking the deal. I looked at my bank account last night and was charged $125 when I'm supposed to be charged $104. I spent about 25 minutes staying up when I needed to go to bed, going back and forth with a gentleman named REMOVEDthat seemed more like an AI bot than anything. I sent him the document I have stating my phone bill should only be $104, and he continued trying to lower my rate in other ways, other than resolving the issue to begin with. After 25 minutes there was no resolution on his end so I ended the chat. I don't have time to sit on the phone for 30 minutes, try to get an Issue resolved that shouldn't have happened to begin with. I also had a loyalty discount for an additional 10 percent off my phone bill for the next 12 months. I don't know if that offer glitched the promotion or what, but I don't have time to deal with this, and I'm going to switch back to T-Mobile if we can't get a resolution. I'm a small business owner and working a 9-5 on top of it, and was about to add a business line to my account, but I'm second-guessing at this point. I remember when I first switched. This was an issue as well, but my salesperson in person was able to get it resolved for me. It seriously seems like whenever I take advantage of a promotion with this company, something gets messed up, and now I have to spend my whole lunch break writing this review

reviews.text: I am writing to formally notify you regarding a serious and ongoing issue that has caused significant financial and personal stress. This message serves as a formal record prior to pursuing legal action.Approximately one year ago, a Verizon representative visited my home with a proposal. reviews.text: I have been a Verizon customer for over 10 years and I have slowly but surely come to the conclusion that they are the absolute worst phone company.They have hidden fees and skyrocket your bills and the store representatives I've dealt with have been nothing but pushy.That is even if you can get an actual live representative because any representative online is actually an automated bot.Theyre scammed and they will rob your bank account before you know it.I went in a few months ago because I was having issues with my phone and the live representative told me their wasnt anything he could do that I had to go online and deal with these automated bots.Dealing with these bots has been nothing but infuriating as they cannot ever truly understand what youre saying nor comprehend what requests you've made.Somehow going in though this representative talked me into trying their home internet, claimed it was free for the first month. So I said I'd try it out. I didnt like it. It didn't work well, so I went to take it back less than two weeks later. That representative told me I had to return it through the online system. I made an attempt to numerous times, dealing with bots who assured me it would be handled. Kept getting the run around but they assured me ai would only be paying for my one phone line [as requested].Now im sitting on a $500 bill less than a month later claiming that I owe them for all sorts of service fees and line connecting fees including not only one but two home internet.Been trying to deal with this for over a week now and getting nothing but run around with their bot system. All I wanted was to be paying for my one phone line but they still are trying to force me to pay for 5 lines (two phone, a tablet [which was supposed to be free] and not 1 but 2 internets)I will not be paying this and I will not be returning to Verizon.

Throughout the process, I received little to no communication. I was not informed that my vehicle would remain there for three days, nor was I offered a loaner or given the option to check availability. My car was not brought to me or cleaned. Instead, I was handed my keys and told to retrieve my car from the back.When I reported my concerns, the manager, REMOVED, stated REMOVEDnormally follows procedures, which raised concerns about inconsistent treatment. When I spoke with REMOVEDto discuss her feedback, she mentioned vehicle cleanliness, communication, and the pickup process, but at no point did she mention any such remark.


Regarding the timeline, our advisor informed REMOVEDupon drop-off on April 3rd that her vehicle would not be worked on or completed until April 6th. Because this was confirmed at the outset, the advisor did not believe a follow-up call on Saturday was necessary to reconfirm the Monday start date.


In terms of cleanliness, we were unable to wash the vehicle because of existing body damage, specifically a detached plastic wheel arch. Please see the attached photo for reference.


Finally, regarding the pickup process, our advisor brought the vehicle inside for the customer. However, because REMOVEDrequested information on a service contract, our advisor, REMOVED, accompanied her to the finance department to review her options. While she was with the finance team, porters moved her vehicle just outside of the service drive.


We apologize for any inconvenience these circumstances may have caused.

complaints.text: I moved from REMOVEDto REMOVEDusing REMOVEDU-55-11119-5), they promised multiple times the quoted price would be the final price. After the delivery was completed they asked for an additional $446.60 for 'additional services'. These additional services were not identified prior to the move. I am now being harassed and forced to make this unplanned payment and so am reporting REMOVEDusing deceptive sales practices.

I am writing to express my extreme dissatisfaction with the services provided by REMOVEDduring my recent move from REMOVED, REMOVEDto REMOVEDon April REMOVED. I engage your company in good faith for a smooth and professional, moving experience. However, what transpired left me deeply disappointed, and seeking resolution.During a zoom call with REMOVED, I clearly outline the items that needed to be removed from my apartment. I also recorded that zoom call. Despite this, the movers arrive with a small truck and only took half of the agreed-upon items. Not only were they behavior, rude and disrespectful, but I was charged the full amount of the move $8476.47 despite only receiving half the service REMOVEDadd insult to injury, I received the call requesting a tip for the driver who was involved who was not involved in the incomplete move. This lack of professionalism and disregard for customer satisfaction is completely unacceptable. Furthermore, the negligence displayed by leaving items behind has caused additional inconvenience, including Unexpected travel, expensive and damages to my property, such as a functioning fireplace.I have attempted to address these issues with your company to know avail. No meaningful effort has been made to rectify the situation or compensate me for the sub standard service I receive. Therefore, I have no choice, but to pursue legal action to recover, have the payment made, cover cost incurred due to the incomplete move, and see restitution for the damage caused.I implore you to take this medicine seriously and respond promptly to resolve these issues before further action is taken. I trust that you will understand the urgency and importance of addressing these concerns to maintain your companies, reputation and integrity.I look forward to a swift and satisfactory resolution SincerelyStanicia HaynesSent from my iPad

I moved from REMOVEDto REMOVEDin August of 2024. I used this company to transport all my possessions cross country from REMOVEDto REMOVEDand upon my belongings arriving in REMOVEDsome of my items were either stolen or missing. I've attempted to resolve this issue with the company but to no avail. I've even asked the company to allow me to file a claim with the insurance that I have in place for restitution on the missing or stolen items that they were responsible for. The company position was that I signed for receiving these items, My position was that I signed for receiving the boxes that the items were supposed to be in but upon unpacking I discovered that the items were not in these boxes. The company final restitution offer was $165.00 and that was for the items that were broken during the transportation of my belongings. I received a check in the mail from the company yesterday but I refuse to cash it and sign off on this transaction. I estimate my losses to be from $2,000 to $2,500. I had major items missing such as REMOVEDXbox ,PS5,IPOD and other electronics. This $165.00 that they are offering me is an insult to me. Since I paid for insurance to cover incidents that may arise such as this ,why can't I be reimburse for my lost. from this company.

We paid over REMOVEDto REMOVEDmoving company to have our belongings moved from REMOVEDand REMOVEDto REMOVED. They use third party services to help with parts of the move. I was told I would need to pay an additional REMOVEDbut instead they are now requesting another REMOVEDfor those services that is overbilled based on time worked and the damage they did to the items. The invoice they sent is vague and I have tried to work with united but havent gotten anywhere- or even a phone number to work with someone to resolve this. I would like the new charges to be accurate based on work completed and to take account to the damages they caused. For example- they charge per hour and one of the charges is 120$ to take a tv off the wall that took them no more than five minutes to do. It did not take a full hour. Another charge was again for the canopy bed that was destroyed by their team and saying it took them an additional 2 hours to put together. The gentlemen that were at the house did not fully assemble the bed and spent the majority of the time at my house out smoking in their truck/ took three separate times to readable the treadmill since they didnt do it correctly.

I completed a moving estimate and was told it could be adjusted down if I manually packed items prior to the move. I did this using my own money for supplies and time for labor. I contacted the business multiple times prior to the move date to re-estimate. They did not respond. After the move they refused to pro-rate because they said the estimate was actually binding. In the inventory they also took credit for packing boxes that had been packed several years before by a prior mover and never unpacked. These boxes clearly had the original movers inventory tags applied with the current move tagged on top of it. They used these overstated boxes to claim it was ok that the estimate wasn't adjusted down because the initial packing estimate was too low anyway. I provided an updated inventory of the boxes actually packed and photos of the boxes they claimed credit for but they said it didn't matter. On a side note, the moving service was also bad. Three pieces of furniture and one box never arrived. My TV was also packed in a TV-only boxes with a bunch of other items and arrived damaged. These issues were addressed, but shows the moving service has issues.

I hired United Regions Van REMOVEDto move my furniture and clothing across country and I paid for expedited delivery with a delivrery date of February 15/16. After paying the sizeable deposit I am being told that they won't be delivering on that date and have no delivery date planned, thus holding my goods hostage. They will also not let me get another company to pick up my goods.REMOVED

REMOVEDpacked and loaded my shipment in REMOVED, REMOVEDin February 2023. They kept the items in storage in REMOVEDand then agreed to deliver them to REMOVED, REMOVEDin July 2023. When the movers came to our new home in REMOVEDthere were multiple boxes missing on the bill of lading (that the movers said weren't even available when they picked up that morning to deliver). In addition to multiple boxes not being available, there was damage to multiple high value items (refrigerator, monitor, dining chairs). Items were clearly repackaged from when they left our home and we signed the documentation and when we finally received them. For example, the fridge had the doors removed, handles removed, screws missing all of which caused damage to a fridge that was less than 2 years old.Lots of items also arrived "loose" - outside of boxes that they were supposed to be in. This included all large items such as couch cushions and lots of garden-related items like shovels, forks, loppers. Some items were found in the moving truck after delivery was supposedly complete and only after we mentioned it to the movers.We bought full insurance with United. There were some professional repair people that came to assess the damaged items first and they fixed one item and we received their assessment a couple of months after the claim was first made. The claims team tried to short change us for many items, denying the extent of the damage, claiming items could not have been in the boxes marked as lost. In the claims process we were also passed back and forth between what we thought were two different United teams but there was some difference between them that was never explained to us. Part of the claim was being seen by one team and part by another and it wasnt clear why.United acknowledged that items were delivered loose which shouldnt happen yet none of the claims were re-assessed.

I had REMOVEDcontracted for my move from my homestead in REMOVEDto Georgia. At the origin the movers were rude to my wife and the woman we had cleaning as the house was cleared out. They also left the doors to the house open allowing chickens into the house. The chickens knocked over a potted plant which was ruined and roosted on my wife's heirloom baby grand piano. The piano was scratched and defaecated on. My belongings were put into storage while I looked for a new home in Georgia. The entire contents of my barn from REMOVEDwere not delivered to my new home. This was primarily agricultural equipment. On top of this half of my childrens' bed was missing (This was discovered by the movers who were attempting to reassemble the bed). An antique rocking horse had its tail broken off. A crockpot was shattered, and the piano was further damaged. I am also missing my child's power wheel and a KitchenAid stand mixer.I filed the claim as instructed. The total amount of the claim was just under $10,000. I was issued a check for less than $500. They denied the piano due to pre-existing damage (which was caused by the movers) they denied the bed because it wasn't claimed at delivery (though it was the movers themselves who discovered that most of it was missing) and they approved a couple of other items in what I can only assume was by arbitrary choice. There was clearly no investigation into the missing items.

State to state move from REMOVEDto REMOVED.Originally contracted through REMOVED.REMOVEDpacked up our items in boxes in REMOVED,my wife was present when this occurred.The Moving truck broke down in REMOVEDafter we were waitng at REMOVEDfor arrival so we had to absorb the travel costs twice.However when the truck broke down in route at some point our stuff was put into storage in REMOVEDuntil we could reschedule appt to receive our stuff.When things were finally delivered many of our items were destroyed ,broken and or water damaged,in fact many of our items were no longer even in boxes or packed as they had been when they left REMOVED.We filed a complaint for item loss with moving company but they wouldn't even come to look at our damages instead asking us to send them pictures of the claimed items which we did.They offererd REMOVEDas settlement and we were unhappy with the offer and went into arbitration,our estimate to replace like for like items was over 40000,arbitration occured and about 1 year later they said that the neutral arbitration came to the same conclusion as the moving company and the exact same settlement offer was put forth.My vintage Rotel stereo equipment was destryed as well as 2 custom built competetion pcs that I had built.they offered us nothing for this.We were required to pay moving insurance as out item list was estimated at over 100000,They destryed many items that cannot be replaced,its not like a bed these electronics were special and they offered us no credit at all for them saying that they were not damaged by mvoing our items several times prior to delivery and the items were unboxed on arrival even though my wife witness the items being packed and boxed at the pick up address.We have all correspondednce and documentation from this move including the aribitration section and I can provide what you need,but with everything is a few hundred pages

I am formally rejecting the response provided by Prosidium Warranty & Capital (PWC) regarding Agreement No. ACFJ00317941W. REMOVEDassertion that the contract is "void" due to internal eligibility requirements is legally insufficient and fails to address the principles of equitable estoppel and contractual performance.

1. Formal Transfer and Validation
REMOVEDclaims the contract is ineligible because it was sold outside of the original vehicle purchase. However, PWC (or its predecessor/administrator) explicitly approved the formal transfer of this contract to me after I purchased the vehicle privately. By accepting the transfer fee and issuing a confirmation, PWC entered into a binding agreement with me.

2. Prior Performance and Detrimental Reliance
PWC admits to approving and paying for a prior repair claim under this agreement. By doing so, REMOVEDaffirmed the validity of the contract through performance. I relied on this affirmation to my detriment, keeping the vehicle and continuing to use the service department at REMOVEDof REMOVEDunder the belief that I was fully covered. REMOVEDcannot retroactively "void" a contract after it has already begun performing its obligations.

3. Agency and Dealership Liability
PWC directs me to the "selling dealership" for a refund. If the contract was truly issued outside of eligibility parameters, then REMOVEDof REMOVED(the selling dealer) acted as an authorized agent of PWC. The dealerships error in selling an "ineligible" contract binds the principal (PWC). Furthermore, the dealerships refund of the premium is an admission of an underlying error but does not cover the consequential damages I have suffered, including:


The unpaid cost of the current oil pump valve repair
Significant loss of use and alternative transportation cost
The diminished trade-in value of the vehicle


Conclusion

reviews.name: Terry G
reviews.text:
Worst company ever! I filled out all of the forms and they just kept saying there were errors without looking at my explanations or having a live person talk to me. Biggest waste of money and time. Our green card was delayed by a year, because we wasted time hiring this company. I hired a real lawyer who I could speak directly to and received the green card so quickly. I am just here to warn others now. You have been warned. Hire a real immigration lawyer and not this company.
Boundless Immigration, Inc.

Date: 09/17/2026

Dear Mr. REMOVEDyou for taking the time to share your feedback. We are truly sorry to hear about your frustration with your experience and the delay you encountered during your immigration journey.

At Boundless, our service is designed to streamline the immigration process by combining guided online tools with thorough document reviews before filing. To ensure our clients always have direct assistance, our support team is available by phone to speak live and help answer any questions related to an application.

We maintain strict document quality guidelines to ensure every filing meets exact USCIS requirements. When our team asks for multiple updates or re-uploads for a document, it is because the file provided is visually flawed, incomplete, or does not match official REMOVEDstandards. While re-uploading documents can feel frustrating, this rigorous review process is designed to protect your petition. Submitting improper documentation risks receiving a Request for Evidence (RFE) from REMOVEDunder tight deadlines, which can cause severe delays or harm the overall outcome of the application.

We appreciate your feedback as we continuously work to improve our communication and customer experience. We are glad that your green card was ultimately approved, and we wish you the very best.

Sincerely,

Boundless Immigration

Then they dont get back to you. You have to get back with them when they tell you that they will call you back. They dont call you back. You have to call them and then you go through a whole bunch of stuff trying to get to the right department to find out that theyre not answering the phones that you have to send an email so I mean if they work through every issue completely and they did what they said they would it would be a whole lot better for people I couldnt imagine trying to go through them if I didnt speak English. reviews.name: Milton W
reviews.text:
I initially chose Boundless because of the support, communication, and guidance they advertised for what is already a very stressful immigration process. Unfortunately, my experience did not reflect those expectations.Throughout the process, I experienced repeated communication delays, unresolved portal/login access issues, inconsistent follow-up, and concerns that I raised multiple times that were either overlooked or never properly addressed. Immigration matters require a high level of trust, attention to detail, and responsiveness, especially when clients are sharing sensitive personal information and relying on guidance for important legal processes. Unfortunately, I did not feel that level of care or support was consistently REMOVEDof the most frustrating aspects of the experience was having to repeatedly explain the same concerns to different representatives without seeing meaningful resolution. I made several good-faith attempts to continue working through the process, but over time the lack of responsiveness and unresolved issues caused me to lose confidence in moving forward with their service.After deciding to cancel, I requested a full refund due to the service concerns I experienced. While the company acknowledged many of the issues I raised, including communication and portal access problems, they ultimately relied on their refund policy and internal case progression to deny the remaining balance of my refund request. A partial refund was issued, but I do not believe it adequately reflected the circumstances surrounding my experience.I strongly encourage anyone considering this service to carefully evaluate whether they are comfortable relying on a primarily online support structure for something as important and detail-oriented as immigration processing. My experience unfortunately left me feeling unsupported, frustrated, and disappointed.
Boundless Immigration, Inc.

Date: 05/22/2026

This reflects the $350.00 in total fees paid, less a 3% third-party payment processing fee that is non-recoverable by Boundless. This processing fee deduction was communicated directly to Mr. REMOVEDby our Payment Solutions team. The refund is expected to post to his account within 5-7 business days.

3. REMOVEDfiling status: We can confirm that no application or documents were filed with REMOVEDon Mr. REMOVEDbehalf. His application was not completed prior to cancellation, so nothing was submitted to the government on his case.

We attempted to reach Mr. REMOVEDdirectly to better understand the specific accessibility barriers he encountered, in hopes of both addressing his concerns and potentially continuing to support him with his application. However, he had already made his decision to move forward with cancellation and refund, which we have honored in full.

We consider this matter resolved, but remain available to Mr. REMOVEDshould he have any further questions.

complaints.text: In November 2024 I paid Boundless Immigration $1,145 to assist with my I-751 Petition to Remove Conditions on Residence, with a filing window opening April 30, 2026. On April 8, 2026, just 22 days before my filing window opened, Boundless withdrew from my case without adequate notice, leaving me to find alternative legal assistance at short notice during a time-sensitive federal immigration filing.I submitted a formal seven-point complaint on April 9, 2026 addressing the following failures: contradictory advice from their staff regarding my case, failure to flag a key document that sat unreviewed in their portal for 12 months, no warning on their website or service agreement that cases involving certain disclosures would be outside their scope, a missing $50 processing fee, and failure to provide my case file upon withdrawal.Since submitting the complaint I have sent multiple follow-up emails, made a phone call during which I was told a manager would respond within 24 hours, and received no substantive response after over two weeks. The 24 hour commitment was broken with no proactive communication.I am seeking a full refund of $1,145 and goodwill compensation of $1500 to offset emergency legal consultation costs incurred as a direct result of their late REMOVEDname: Boundless Immigration / Boundless REMOVEDBusiness address: REMOVED(licensed in REMOVED, license REMOVEDpaid: $1,145
complaints.businessResponse:
Dear REMOVED, 

Thank you for your feedback. We sincerely regret the frustration caused by the timing of our withdrawal from your case. Our goal is to ensure every applicant has the best possible chance of success, and we would like to clarify the steps taken to resolve your concerns.

Scope of Service and Professional Review: At Boundless, all cases undergo a specialized review process. During the final assessment of your I-751 application, an Independent Immigration Attorney (IIA) determined that the complexities of your specific legal history required a level of representation that falls outside our standard scope of service. This determination was made to ensure you have the opportunity to secure specialized counsel better suited to your unique filing needs.

Full Refund of Fees: To ensure you have the necessary resources to transition to a new representative, we have returned your total $1,195 investment. The primary service fee of $1,145 was initiated on April 10, 2026, and the remaining processing fees were initiated last Friday. You have now been reimbursed 100% of the funds paid to our firm; please allow the standard REMOVEDyour account depending on your financial institution.

Case File Delivery: We recognize the importance of your upcoming filing window. To assist in your transition, our team has manually compiled your case information and documents, which were sent to your email on April 25, 2026. This ensures you have your prepared materials ready for immediate use with a private attorney.

While we understand your request for additional compensation, we have provided a full refund of all fees paid to Boundless. Our aim in returning these funds and providing your prepared documents is to ensure you are fully equipped to secure the specialized counsel required for your case.

Sincerely,

complaints.text: Payment $1,249 on July 4, 2025.Boundless advertised and sold a premium immigration service for green cards, including guided application preparation, document review, and access to attorney consultations. I understood this to include ongoing support and substantive assistance throughout my case.Nature of the Dispute:This dispute involves failure to disclose material terms, failure to provide the level of service purchased, lack of follow-up, and resulting financial harm.Material terms, including a 14-day refund limitation and a one-year service agreement, were not disclosed when we created the account or being sold the dream on the phone. These terms would have directly impacted my decision to proceed. I believed the service would remain available and that the company would honor the full value of my payment.The services provided were minimal, and my case never progressed beyond the first step. No meaningful progress was made.A scheduled attorney consultation did not take place because my case never advanced past the first step, preventing access to services I paid for.I was also influenced by a sales representative who emphasized urgency to act immediately, which contributed to my decision and led to additional expenses related to my wifes situation.Regarding follow-up, I received approximately 23 emails in 250 days; however, only one referenced continuing my case. The 1 of the 23 say I only have 90 days left on my account. Whether the Business Has Tried to Resolve the Problem:The boundlesss offered a one-time extension of about 90 days. This was insufficient due to my spouses situation requiring 924 months. When I requested a refund, I was told refunds are not offered, though I was also led on to think I had a strong case. The business then canceled my account without issuing a refund.
complaints.businessResponse:
Dear REMOVED,

Thank you for taking the time to share your concerns in detail. We truly understand how frustrating this experience has been, and we appreciate the opportunity to address your feedback.

Were sorry to hear that the service did not meet your expectations, particularly regarding communication, case progress, and clarity around account terms. 

Regarding your account, while our refund policy is limited to the initial period after purchase, we want to continue supporting you moving forward. Instead of closing your account, we will keep it open so you can proceed with your Adjustment of Status (AOS) application when you are ready. This way, you can still make full use of the services included in your package once your circumstances allow.

We understand that your timeline may extend beyond what was initially anticipated, and our goal is to ensure youre still able to benefit from the service you purchased when the time is right.

Please let us know when youre ready to move forward, and well be here to assist you every step of the way.

Thank you again for your feedback and for giving us the opportunity to support you.

 

Sincerely,

The Boundless Team

complaints.text: I had signed up for the REMOVEDprocess with my partner on a payment plan starting with an initial deposit of $250 on 8/5/2025. I completed the application and questionnaire and hoped to have continued with the plan but I had medical circumstances that required me to pause the process. My bank says that Boundless attempted to withdraw the next payments but did not go through. In the end we were able to obtain free legal aid based on my medical circumstances and we discovered that the application fee is only around $700-800 vs the $1500 that would have been spent on Boundless for legal review but no actual lawyer on my side.I had requested a refund of the deposit a few months ago but did not receive a response and this week, Jessan and REMOVEDmessaged me on email saying I am in default and have to pay to continue service but I mentioned the request and they are denying the request because of a "14 day window" However no service whatsoever has been rendered so it is difficult to understand why they are refusing the refund request.I kindly request that Boundless return the $250 deposit as no service was rendered. I would understand if the application was sent in but no such thing has occured yet. Thank you.
complaints.businessResponse:
Dear REMOVED,

Thank you for reaching out and for sharing your situation. Were sorry to hear about your medical circumstances and hope things have improved.

Wed like to clarify the structure of the K-1 REMOVEDplan purchased on 8/6/2025:
K-1 REMOVEDFee: $720.00
USCIS Filing Fees: $675.00
Boundless Government Fee Service Cost: $105.00
Total: $1,500.00 (this package does not include attorney review)

Regarding your refund request, Boundless maintains a 14-day refund policy from the date of purchase. This policy ensures consistency, as account setup and access to our platform begin shortly after enrollment.

Based on our records, we did not receive a refund request within that timeframe. The request was raised after the account became past due, which falls outside the eligibility window outlined in our policy.

We also want to clarify that services had already been initiated. Upon enrollment, you were granted access to our platform to begin the application and questionnaire process, which is a core part of our service and designed to guide applicants through REMOVEDrequirements. As a result, this would not be considered a case where no service was rendered.

We understand that your circumstances changed and respect your decision to pursue an alternative path. However, the refund policy applies consistently in these situations.

If you have any additional questions or would like to discuss possible next steps, please let us know.

 

Sincerely,

The Boundless Team

complaints.text:
I purchased a marriage-based green card preparation service from Boundless Immigration on September 5, 2025 (Receipt #REMOVED-9003), paying a total of $1,874, including $1,149 in preparation fees, $675 in USCIS filing fees, and a $50 service fee.The application was never submitted to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. The company confirmed this by refunding the $675 government filing fee. In their communication, they also stated that my case is currently in the Customer QA stage, meaning the application has not been finalized or prepared for submission.Despite the application not being completed or filed, the company has refused to provide any refund of the $1,149 preparation fee, citing a 14-day refund policy. However, their own terms indicate that refunds outside this period may be issued at their discretion. No explanation has been provided as to why discretion was not applied in this case, despite the service not being completed.Additionally, the company has offered to retain the funds as a credit for future use, which indicates the service has not been fully rendered.I am requesting a full or partial refund of the preparation fee, as the core servicecompletion and submission of the immigration applicationwas never delivered.
Customer Answer

Date: 03/22/2026

Hello,

I am writing regarding my complaint filed with the Better Business Bureau against Boundless Immigration. My name is REMOVED, and my complaint ID is #REMOVED.

After submitting the complaint, the company, Boundless Immigration, contacted me directly by email rather than responding through the BBB system. In their message, they reiterated that they would not provide a refund of the preparation fee.

However, the immigration application associated with this service was never completed or submitted to U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services. The company confirmed that the case remained in the REMOVEDstage and refunded the $675 government filing fee because no filing occurred.

I wanted to ensure that this communication is documented within my BBB complaint record. I remain open to a reasonable resolution and am seeking a full or partial refund of the preparation fee given that the final deliverablea completed immigration application ready for submissionwas never provided.

Thank you for your time and assistance.

Kind regards,

reviews.name: Kimberly Z
reviews.text:
We all need to move at one time or another right? I have moved in REMOVEDquite a few times over last 30 years. I was driving into work and passed an Affordable Movers truck headed out towards my area. I was in need of movers for my last really big awkward hutch, two heavy book shelves, head board and foot board and gave them a call for bid. Process was smoother than the two other big movers I had called the previous month. Price was very reasonable. I was moving out of a storage unit- not an option so I chose the studio apt option. They met me at my storage unit, I was loading up rest of my items in my cargo trailer and they were taking the big heavy items I cannot lift. I needed muscle to move them since I had stairs to get them in my home.They were very professional. They asked about the studio REMOVEDand told them the storage unit wasn't an option. They saw I was moving out rest of my items and asked "all this going to same place ?" "Yes" " ok let's take some in truck as well". Reduced moving stress immediately!!! I had a coffee table I had forgot was there and gorilla racks as well as some heavy boxes of books and my grandmothers china. All in all we had everything pack up in 30 minutes!!! Headed to my home and moving in was another thing since I had 5 stairs into house. The guys were so good working together safely moving the heavy items and took great care moving them. I have hired other movers and moved myself with help of friends quite few times and this was the BEST experience . Items were wrapped and moved with care. Guys were friendly and very professional. Even have talked to owner just to relay my experience how much I appreciated his two guys. If I have any moving needs again I know who I am calling for the job. Give them a call and get a free bid. Highly recommend!!!
Affordable Movers LLC

Date: 07/08/2025

Thank you so much CB REMOVEDfor going above and beyond to give such such thorough feedback. It means the world to us. So glad the guys were able to take good care of you and make your move smooth as possible. We appreciate your recommendation and your business.  Thank you thank you.
